addData.title: Add Data

xyz.label: Add XYZ Layer
xyz.description: Add a raster tile template using x, y, and z placeholders.

wms.label: Add WMS Layer
wms.description: Add a WMS GetMap service as a tiled raster layer.

wfs.label: Add WFS Layer
wfs.description: Add WFS features by requesting GeoJSON from a GetFeature service.

wmts.label: Add WMTS Layer
wmts.description: Add a WMTS tile URL template as a raster layer.

ogcFeatures.label: Add OGC API - Features Layer
ogcFeatures.description: Add features from an OGC API - Features collection as a vector layer, following the service's paging links until the requested feature count is loaded.

ogcVectorTiles.label: Add OGC Vector Tiles
ogcVectorTiles.description: Add an OGC API - Tiles (vector) service from a TileJSON or tile template, optionally reading its source layers from a style URL.

gpx.label: Add GPX Layer
gpx.description: Add GPX waypoints, routes, and tracks as one or more vector layers.

georss.label: Add GeoRSS Layer
georss.description: Add a GeoRSS feed (RSS, Atom, or RDF) from a URL or file as a vector layer.

delimitedText.label: Add Delimited Text Layer
delimitedText.description: Add a delimited text file or URL as a point layer using longitude and latitude fields, by geocoding an address column, or as a non-spatial attribute table when no coordinates are available.

cad.label: Add CAD (DXF/DWG) Layer
cad.description: Add an AutoCAD DXF or DWG drawing as a vector layer, choosing which layer to load and the coordinate reference system to project it from.

gdb.label: Add File Geodatabase Layer
gdb.description: Add a layer from an Esri File Geodatabase (.gdb folder). The layer is read with the local GeoLibre server and reprojected to WGS84.

photos.label: Add Geotagged Photos
photos.description: Import JPEG/HEIC photos as a point layer, placing each one from its EXIF GPS location.

mbtiles.label: Add MBTiles Layer
mbtiles.description: Add a local MBTiles file as a raster or vector tile layer.

arcgis.label: Add ArcGIS Layer
arcgis.description: Add an ArcGIS FeatureServer, VectorTileServer, MapServer, or ImageServer layer, or a portal item.

postgres.label: Add PostgreSQL Layer
postgres.description: Start Martin locally, discover PostGIS sources, and add a source as vector tiles.

iceberg.label: Add Apache Iceberg Layer
iceberg.description: Read an Iceberg table (v3 or above) and add a subset of its features.

deckglViz.label: Add Deck.gl Layer
deckglViz.description: Pick a deck.gl layer type, then load the example data or upload a CSV/JSON/GeoJSON file or URL.

video.label: Add Video Layer
video.description: Add a georeferenced video overlay by supplying an MP4 URL and four corner coordinates.

polyline.label: Add Encoded Polyline Layer
polyline.description: Import encoded polyline strings (Google, OSRM, Valhalla) from text or files as vector lines.

env.tokenDescription: Project > Share uses this token to upload your maps to {{shareHost}}. Open <tokenLink>{{shareHost}}/settings</tokenLink>, create a token under Settings > API tokens, then paste it into the field below.
env.tokenStorageNote: Stored locally on this device and sent only to {{shareHost}} to authenticate uploads. On the web build it shares the same browser storage as other site data, so revoke it on {{shareHost}} if your machine is compromised.
env.tokenUnavailable: This deployment has no project sharing server configured, so no API token is needed.
env.tokenHostInvalid: This deployment's project sharing server address is not valid, so this token cannot be used.
env.cesiumTokenDescription: The 3D globe (a split-view pane) uses Cesium Ion world imagery and terrain, which need an access token. Create a free account at <tokenLink>ion.cesium.com/tokens</tokenLink>, copy your default access token, and paste it below. Without a token the 3D globe toggle is hidden.
env.cesiumTokenStorageNote: Stored locally on this device (not in the project file, so it is never shared) and sent only to Cesium Ion. On the web build it shares the same browser storage as other site data.
env.secretsWarning: Values are stored in plain text in the project file and may be exposed when the project is shared. Avoid putting secrets here unless the project file stays private.
env.errorNamePattern: Environment variable names must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores.
env.stripPromptDesc: This project has {{count}} credential-bearing field(s), such as API keys, request headers, or plugin settings. Remove them from the saved file? The current workspace keeps them either way.

conversion.zipInputBrowserError: Zipped Shapefiles can only be converted in the GeoLibre desktop app. In the browser, select the unzipped .shp together with its .dbf, .shx, and .prj files.
conversion.browserOutputUnsupported: In the browser, the output can be GeoJSON, CSV, GeoParquet, GeoPackage, FlatGeobuf, or Shapefile (.zip). ".{{extension}}" output needs the GeoLibre desktop app.
conversion.outputExtensionRequired: Add a file extension to the output name to choose the format.
conversion.needsDesktop: This conversion needs the GeoLibre desktop app or a running sidecar.
conversion.runsInBrowserDuckDb: Conversion runs in your browser with DuckDB-WASM.
conversion.runsInBrowserWriters: Conversion runs in your browser with DuckDB-WASM and the bundled writers.
conversion.runsInBrowserWasm: Conversion runs in your browser with geolibre-wasm. No sidecar needed.
conversion.wroteCog: Wrote a tiled COG with overviews ({{compression}})
conversion.notAGeoTiff: This file is not a readable GeoTIFF. In the browser, Raster to COG reads GeoTIFF only; other formats need the desktop app.
conversion.rasterTooLargeForBrowser: In the browser this decodes the whole raster in WebAssembly, which is limited to about 4 GB, so this one does not fit. Convert it with the GeoLibre desktop app, or build the COG beforehand with gdal_translate or rio-cogeo.
conversion.zoomRangeError: Zoom levels must satisfy 0 ≤ min ≤ max ≤ {{max}}.
conversion.rasterToPmtilesDesc: Render a raster into a single PMTiles archive of Web Mercator PNG tiles, ready for cloud-native serving. One band is rendered through a colormap, so multi-band imagery is not drawn in true colour. Runs entirely in WebAssembly, so it needs no sidecar on either the web or desktop app.
conversion.cogBrowserNote: In the browser, 8-bit rasters keep their type and everything else (Int16 DEMs, Float64, …) is written as Float32. The desktop app preserves the original type.
conversion.notAGeoTiffRasterOnly: This file is not a readable GeoTIFF. Raster to PMTiles reads GeoTIFF only, on both the web and desktop app.
conversion.bandError: Band must be a positive whole number.
conversion.bandOutOfRange: Band {{band}} does not exist; this raster has {{bands}} band(s).
conversion.runsInBrowserVectorEngines: Conversion runs in your browser with DuckDB-WASM, or geolibre-wasm for FlatGeobuf output.
conversion.vectorToVectorDesc: Convert between any vector formats DuckDB's spatial extension supports. The input and output formats are detected from the file extensions. The desktop app writes any format (FlatGeobuf, GeoPackage, Shapefile, KML, GML, …); the browser writes GeoJSON, CSV, GeoParquet, GeoPackage, FlatGeobuf, and Shapefile.
conversion.vectorToGeoparquetDesc: Convert a vector dataset to a Hilbert-sorted, compressed GeoParquet file optimized for cloud-native range requests.
conversion.vectorToFlatgeobufDesc: Convert a vector dataset to a Hilbert-sorted FlatGeobuf with a packed spatial index for fast cloud-native access.
conversion.vectorToShapefileDesc: Convert a vector dataset to a zipped ESRI Shapefile (.shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj). Field names are truncated to 10 characters.
conversion.vectorToGeopackageDesc: Convert a vector dataset to a GeoPackage (.gpkg) for sharing with QGIS, ArcGIS, and other GIS tools.
conversion.csvToGeoparquetDesc: Build point geometries from longitude/latitude columns and write a Hilbert-sorted, compressed GeoParquet.
conversion.vectorToPmtilesDesc: Tile a vector dataset into a single PMTiles archive of vector tiles, ready for cloud-native serving.
conversion.rasterToCogDesc: Convert a raster dataset to a valid, compressed Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF with internal tiling and overviews.
conversion.shapefileSidecarHint: For Shapefiles, select the .shp together with its .dbf, .shx, and .prj files.

item.openProjectFromUrlDesc: Load a `.geolibre.json` project and add it to recent projects.
item.saveProjectAsDesc: Enter a file name. The project will download to your browser's downloads folder when you click Save.
item.embedVectorDesc: This project has {{count}} local vector layer(s) loaded from your computer. The browser cannot re-read them when the project is reopened, so their data must be embedded in the project file to be restored. Embedding adds about {{size}} to the file.
item.embedVectorDescDesktop: This project has {{count}} local vector layer(s) loaded from your computer. Embed their data to make the project self-contained (adds about {{size}}), or save file references that reload from disk when the project is reopened. References keep the file small but break if a source file is later moved or deleted.
item.embedVectorLargeWarning: Embedding about {{size}} makes a very large project file. Reopening it may be slow or fail outright, because every feature has to be parsed and held in memory at once. For data this size, convert the layers to PMTiles or FlatGeobuf and add them as remote layers instead of embedding them.
item.exportHtmlAsDesc: Enter a file name. The HTML page will download to your browser's downloads folder when you click Save.
item.directionsNoticeTitle: Directions uses a public routing server
item.directionsNoticeDesc: Turning on Directions sends the waypoints you place to the public OSRM demo server (router.project-osrm.org) to calculate routes — your coordinates leave your device for those requests. The demo server is rate-limited and supports driving only.
item.reverseGeocodeTooltip: Click the map to look up an address. The clicked coordinates are sent to the configured geocoding provider (public Nominatim by default; change it in Settings → Geocoding).
item.reverseGeocodeNoticeTitle: Reverse Geocode uses an external service
item.reverseGeocodeNoticeDesc: Turning on Reverse Geocode sends the coordinates of each point you click to the configured geocoding provider (the public Nominatim service by default) to resolve an address — your coordinates leave your device for those requests. You can choose a different provider in Settings → Geocoding.
item.networkNoticeTitle: Network analysis uses an external routing server
item.networkNoticeDesc: Running a Network analysis tool sends the coordinates of your input points to a routing server to compute isochrones, cost matrices, and routes.
item.networkNoticePrivacy: Your input coordinates leave this device and are sent to the public Valhalla server at valhalla1.openstreetmap.de. Press Cancel if your project is bound by data privacy or data-sovereignty rules.
item.networkNoticePrivacyCustom: Your input coordinates leave this device and are sent to the configured routing server ({{endpoint}}). Press Cancel if your project is bound by data privacy or data-sovereignty rules.
item.networkNoticePerformance: The public server is free but rate-limited, so large batches of points may be throttled or fail. For heavy use, run your own Valhalla server and enter its URL in the tool's "Routing server (Valhalla)" field (or set VITE_ROUTING_ENDPOINT in Settings → Environment Variables to make it the default).
item.largeOsmPbfDesc: This file is about {{sizeMb}} MB. Parsing it converts every feature to GeoJSON in memory, which can be slow and may use a lot of memory in the browser. Continue?
item.largeVectorDesc: {{name}} has about {{count}} features. Loading it converts every feature to GeoJSON in memory and may slow down or freeze the app. Continue?
item.addOsmPbfLayerDesc: Load an OpenStreetMap .osm.pbf file. It is parsed in your browser and split into separate point, line, and polygon layers.
item.osmPbfUrlHint: Remote URLs load in the desktop app; in the browser the server must allow cross-origin requests (CORS).
item.loadingOsmPbfDesc: Parsing the file and converting features to GeoJSON. This runs in the background and may take a moment for large extracts.
item.loadingOsmPbfProgress: Converting features to GeoJSON… {{processed}} of {{total}} OSM entities processed.
item.pointerElevationNoticeTitle: Elevation uses a public elevation service
item.pointerElevationNoticeDesc: The status bar's elevation readout is resolved from the map's own 3D terrain when that is enabled, which sends nothing anywhere. Without 3D terrain it falls back to the public Open-Meteo elevation API, and the coordinates under your pointer leave your device for those requests.

buffer.name: Buffer
buffer.description: Create a buffer polygon around each feature by a fixed distance

centroids.name: Centroids
centroids.description: Compute the centroid point of each feature

convex-hull.name: Convex hull
convex-hull.description: Compute the convex hull enclosing all features

dissolve.name: Dissolve
dissolve.description: Merge polygon features into a single geometry, optionally grouped by a field

field.label: Dissolve field (optional)
field.description: Property name to group features by before dissolving

bounding-box.name: Bounding box
bounding-box.description: Compute the rectangular envelope of all features

simplify.name: Simplify
simplify.description: Reduce the number of vertices using Douglas-Peucker

clip.name: Clip
clip.description: Clip the input layer to the area covered by an overlay layer (keeps input attributes)

intersection.name: Intersection
intersection.description: Keep only the areas where both polygon layers overlap

difference.name: Difference
difference.description: Remove the overlay layer's area from the input layer

union.name: Union
union.description: Merge two polygon layers into a single combined geometry

spatial-join.name: Spatial join
spatial-join.description: Attach attributes from a join layer to each input feature based on a spatial relationship

attribute-join.name: Attribute join
attribute-join.description: Attach attributes from a join layer (a table) onto each input feature where a key field matches, without using geometry. One-to-one: the first matching join row wins.

overlay.label: Join layer (table)
overlay.description: The layer whose attributes are brought over. Its geometry is ignored.

fields.label: Fields to bring over (optional)
fields.description: Comma-separated join fields to copy. Leave blank to bring over every join field except the key.

select-by-value.name: Select by value
select-by-value.description: Extract features whose attribute value matches a condition into a new layer

value.label: Value
value.description: Compared as a number when both sides are numeric.

select-by-location.name: Select by location
select-by-location.description: Extract features by their spatial relationship to a second layer into a new layer

random-extract.name: Random extract
random-extract.description: Extract a random subset of features into a new layer, sized by a feature count or a percentage of the input.

count.label: Number of features
count.description: Clamped to the number of input features when larger.

reproject.name: Reproject
reproject.description: Reinterpret a layer's coordinates as a source CRS and transform them to WGS84 so they display in the correct location. Requires the Sidecar or Python engine.

source_crs.label: Source CRS
source_crs.description: The CRS the layer's coordinates are really in (e.g. EPSG:3857). The result is transformed to WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

explode.name: Explode
explode.description: Split multipart geometries into single-part features (one feature per part), keeping each parent's attributes

aggregate.name: Aggregate by attribute
aggregate.description: Dissolve features that share an attribute value into one geometry per group, with a summary statistic

stat_field.label: Statistic field
stat_field.description: Numeric field summarized by the statistic above.

smooth.name: Smooth
smooth.description: Round the corners of line and polygon features with Chaikin's algorithm (adds vertices), distinct from Simplify's vertex reduction. Z/elevation is preserved; points pass through unchanged.

iterations.label: Iterations
iterations.description: More iterations give a smoother result (1-10).

extract-vertices.name: Extract vertices
extract-vertices.description: Convert every vertex of the input features into a point, keeping the original attributes plus vertex_index and part_index columns (same-named source attributes are overwritten)

points-along-geometry.name: Points along geometry
points-along-geometry.description: Generate points at a fixed distance interval along lines and polygon boundaries; the first and last vertices are always included. Each point gets a distance column (a same-named source attribute is overwritten)

grid.name: Regular grid
grid.description: Generate a regular rectangular grid (fishnet) of cells over an extent. Source: the current map view, a layer's extent, or a manual bounding box.

cell_height.label: Cell height (degrees)
cell_height.description: Leave blank to match the cell width.

voronoi.name: Voronoi / Delaunay
voronoi.description: Build a Voronoi diagram (one polygon per point, clipped to the points' extent) or a Delaunay triangulation from a point layer.

cell-sectors.name: Cell-site coverage
cell-sectors.description: Build antenna sector/wedge polygons from point sites using azimuth, radius and beamwidth (read from attribute fields or fixed values). Beamwidth is clamped to 360° (a full circle); the recorded beamwidth reflects the clamped value. Useful for cell-tower coverage, like QGIS Shape Tools.

azimuthField.label: Azimuth field (°)
azimuthField.description: Direction the sector faces, in degrees clockwise from north. Falls back to the fixed azimuth when blank or non-numeric.

radiusField.label: Radius field
radiusField.description: Coverage radius. Falls back to the fixed radius when blank or non-numeric.

beamwidthField.label: Beamwidth field (°)
beamwidthField.description: Angular width of the sector, clamped to 360° (a full circle). Falls back to the fixed beamwidth when blank or non-numeric.

decode-polyline.name: Decode polyline
decode-polyline.description: Decode encoded polyline strings from an attribute field into a LineString vector layer

field.label: Polyline field
field.description: Attribute field containing the encoded polyline string

encode-polyline.name: Encode line to polyline
encode-polyline.description: Encode LineString and MultiLineString geometries into an encoded polyline attribute string

targetField.label: Output field name
targetField.description: Name of the attribute column to store encoded polylines (default: polyline)

dggs-grid.name: DGGS Generator
dggs-grid.description: Fill an area with DGGS cells (H3, S2, A5, DGGRID, DGGAL). Source: a layer's geometry, a layer's extent, the current map view, or a manual bounding box.

dggridType.label: DGGRID type
dggridType.description: Grid configuration passed to duck_dggs as dggs_params (ISEA/FULLER × aperture × topology).

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Range depends on DGGS type. Leave blank to auto-pick from the area.

compactCells.label: Compact cells
compactCells.description: Merge complete sets of sibling cells into coarser parents (fewer features, mixed resolutions).

fixAntimeridian.label: Fix antimeridian
fixAntimeridian.description: Unwrap cell rings that cross ±180° longitude.

dggs-bin.name: DGGS Binning
dggs-bin.description: Aggregate a point layer into DGGS cells (count, or sum/mean/min/max of a numeric field).

dggridType.label: DGGRID type
dggridType.description: Grid configuration passed to duck_dggs as dggs_params (ISEA/FULLER × aperture × topology).

field.label: Field
field.description: Numeric field to aggregate.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Range depends on DGGS type. Leave blank to auto-pick from the area.

fixAntimeridian.label: Fix antimeridian
fixAntimeridian.description: Unwrap cell rings that cross ±180° longitude.

dggs-compact.name: DGGS Compact
dggs-compact.description: Compact DGGS polygon cells, or expand them to a uniform resolution (H3, S2, A5, DGGAL). Input must be a cell layer with an ID property.

layer.label: Input DGGS layer
layer.description: Polygon cell layer from DGGS Generator / Binning (or equivalent).

cellField.label: Cell ID field
cellField.description: Defaults to h3, a5, s2, or dggal for the selected type when left blank.

resolution.label: Target resolution
resolution.description: Resolution to expand to. Must be at least as fine as the input cells.

fixAntimeridian.label: Fix antimeridian
fixAntimeridian.description: Unwrap cell rings that cross ±180° longitude.

trajectory-speed.name: Trajectory speed
trajectory-speed.description: Order points by time (per target) and connect consecutive fixes into segments carrying distance, duration and speed. Like QGIS TrajecTools.

timeField.label: Time field
timeField.description: Timestamp per fix: an ISO date/time string or an epoch (seconds or milliseconds).

idField.label: Target id field
idField.description: Splits the points into separate trajectories. Leave blank to treat all points as one target.

detect-stops.name: Detect stops
detect-stops.description: Find places where a target dwells: runs of consecutive fixes that stay within a distance (absorbing GPS scatter) for at least a minimum duration. Outputs one point per stop. Like QGIS TrajecTools.

timeField.label: Time field
timeField.description: Timestamp per fix: an ISO date/time string or an epoch (seconds or milliseconds).

idField.label: Target id field
idField.description: Detects stops per target. Leave blank to treat all points as one target.

maxDistance.label: Max distance
maxDistance.description: Every fix in a stop must be within this distance of the stop's first fix (so a stop can span up to twice this value). Set it to your GPS scatter radius.

minDuration.label: Min duration (s)
minDuration.description: A dwell shorter than this is not reported as a stop.

space-time-proximity.name: Space-time proximity
space-time-proximity.description: Find pairs of points close in both space and time — e.g. two targets meeting. Outputs a line connecting each qualifying pair, carrying the distance and time gap.

timeField.label: Time field
timeField.description: Timestamp per point: an ISO date/time string or an epoch (seconds or milliseconds).

idField.label: Target id field
idField.description: When set, only points with DIFFERENT id values are paired (encounters between distinct targets). Leave blank to consider every pair.

merge-layers.name: Merge layers
merge-layers.description: Combine several vector layers into one, uniting their attribute schemas (missing attributes become null)

layers.label: Input layers
layers.description: Select two or more layers; they are concatenated in the order shown

addSourceField.label: Add source layer field
addSourceField.description: Record each output feature's originating layer name

sourceFieldName.label: Source field name
sourceFieldName.description: Name of the field that stores the originating layer name

check-validity.name: Check validity
check-validity.description: Find features with invalid geometry (GEOS rules: self-intersecting rings, holes outside shells, ...) and mark them on the map

fix-geometries.name: Fix geometries
fix-geometries.description: Repair invalid geometries with ST_MakeValid (GEOS); valid features pass through untouched

check-topology-rules.name: Check topology rules
check-topology-rules.description: Validate the layer against topology rules (overlaps, gaps, self-intersections, dangles) and mark each violation on the map

rulePointCovered.label: Points must be covered by a line

ruleEndpointSnap.label: Line endpoints must connect within tolerance

snapTolerance.label: Snap tolerance
snapTolerance.description: For the endpoint rule: how far apart (in layer coordinate units — degrees for WGS84) two line ends may be and still count as connected.

fix-topology.name: Fix topology
fix-topology.description: Automatically repair topology violations: snap nearly-connected line endpoints, fix dangles, and project points onto lines. Free ends with nothing nearby are left unchanged.

ruleDangles.label: Repair dangles (snap or project onto nearby geometry)

rulePointCovered.label: Project points onto the nearest line

snapTolerance.label: Snap tolerance
snapTolerance.description: How far (in layer coordinate units — degrees for WGS84) geometry may move to connect.

dryRun.label: Preview only (dry run)
dryRun.description: Report the fixes that would be applied without creating a repaired layer.

isochrone.name: Isochrone / service area
isochrone.description: Travel-time or travel-distance reachability polygons from each point in a layer

contours.label: Contours
contours.description: Comma-separated values (minutes for time, km for distance)

od-matrix.name: OD cost matrix
od-matrix.description: Travel time and distance between every origin and destination point, as connecting lines

sequential-route.name: Sequential route (directions)
sequential-route.description: Connect points in sequence along the road network into a route. Each point is snapped to the nearest road, so off-road coordinates (cell sites, sensors) still route. Order follows the chosen field (e.g. a timestamp) or the layer's feature order.

order_field.label: Order by field (optional)
order_field.description: Sort points by this field (numbers or timestamps) before routing. Leave empty to use the layer's feature order.

global-morans-i.name: Global Moran's I
global-morans-i.description: Measure overall spatial autocorrelation of a numeric attribute across the whole layer.

weightsType.label: Spatial weights
weightsType.description: How neighbors are defined for each feature.

permutations.label: Permutations
permutations.description: Random permutations for the pseudo p-value.

local-morans-i.name: Local Moran's I (LISA)
local-morans-i.description: Per-feature clusters and outliers (High-High, Low-Low, High-Low, Low-High) with pseudo significance.

weightsType.label: Spatial weights
weightsType.description: How neighbors are defined for each feature.

permutations.label: Permutations
permutations.description: Random permutations for the pseudo p-value.

getis-ord-gi.name: Getis-Ord Gi* hotspots
getis-ord-gi.description: Identify statistically significant hot spots and cold spots of a numeric attribute.

weightsType.label: Spatial weights
weightsType.description: How neighbors are defined for each feature.

average-nearest-neighbor.name: Average nearest neighbor
average-nearest-neighbor.description: Test whether points are clustered, dispersed, or randomly distributed (ANN ratio + z-score).

kernel-density.name: Kernel density (heatmap)
kernel-density.description: Estimate a density surface from points as a grid of cells, using a quartic kernel.

weightField.label: Weight field (optional)
weightField.description: Numeric field weighting each point; blank = equal weight.

emerging-hot-spot.name: Emerging Hot Spot (space-time cube)
emerging-hot-spot.description: Build a space-time cube from timestamped points (a fishnet grid × equal time steps) and classify each cell as a new, intensifying, persistent, diminishing, sporadic, oscillating, or historical hot/cold spot. Runs Getis-Ord Gi* per time slice, then a Mann-Kendall trend test on each cell's Gi* series. Client-side, like ArcGIS Emerging Hot Spot Analysis.

timeField.label: Time field
timeField.description: Timestamp per point: an ISO date/time string or an epoch (seconds or milliseconds).

cellSize.label: Cell size (km)
cellSize.description: Edge length of each square spatial bin, in kilometres.

weightField.label: Weight field (optional)
weightField.description: Numeric field summed per space-time bin instead of counting points; blank = count points.

confidence.label: Confidence level
confidence.description: Significance threshold for a bin to count as a hot/cold spot and for the trend.

hillshade.name: Hillshade
hillshade.description: Compute a shaded-relief (hillshade) raster from an elevation model.

slope.name: Slope
slope.description: Compute slope (steepness) from an elevation model.

aspect.name: Aspect
aspect.description: Compute aspect (compass direction of the steepest slope) from an elevation model.

reproject.name: Reproject
reproject.description: Warp a raster to a different coordinate reference system.

dst_crs.label: Target CRS
dst_crs.description: An authority code such as EPSG:3857 or EPSG:4326.

resample.name: Resample
resample.description: Resample a raster to a different pixel size (resolution).

resolution.label: Target pixel size
resolution.description: Output pixel size in the raster's CRS units.

clip-extent.name: Clip by extent
clip-extent.description: Crop a raster to a bounding box (in the raster's CRS).

clip-mask.name: Clip by mask layer
clip-mask.description: Clip a raster to the geometries of a vector mask file.

mask_path.label: Mask layer
mask_path.description: A GeoJSON file whose geometries define the clip region. It is reprojected to the raster's CRS automatically (a GeoJSON with no CRS is assumed to be WGS84).

polygonize.name: Polygonize
polygonize.description: Convert a raster band into vector polygons grouped by pixel value.

contour.name: Contour
contour.description: Generate contour lines from an elevation model.

interval.label: Interval
interval.description: Elevation difference between successive contour lines.

interpolate.name: Interpolation (IDW / Kriging)
interpolate.description: Interpolate a point layer's numeric attribute into a continuous raster surface using inverse distance weighting or ordinary kriging.

field.label: Value field
field.description: Name of the numeric point attribute to interpolate (e.g. elevation, temperature).

resolution.label: Output pixel size
resolution.description: Cell size in the layer's CRS units (degrees for WGS84). The grid covers the points' extent.

power.label: IDW power
power.description: Higher values give nearby points more influence.

variogram_model.label: Variogram model
variogram_model.description: Theoretical model fitted to the empirical semivariogram. Kriging is capped at 1500 points.

zonal.name: Zonal statistics
zonal.description: Summarize raster values within each polygon of a vector layer (count, min, max, mean, sum, std, median).

zones_path.label: Zones layer
zones_path.description: A GeoJSON polygon layer defining the zones. It is reprojected to the raster's CRS automatically (a GeoJSON with no CRS is assumed to be WGS84).

prefix.label: Field prefix
prefix.description: Prepended to each statistic field name (e.g. 'dem_' → 'dem_mean'). Leave blank for bare 'mean', 'min', …

raster-calc.name: Raster calculator
raster-calc.description: Evaluate a NumPy band-math expression. Reference band 1 of each input as A, B, C and specific bands as A1, A2, …; e.g. NDVI is (A2 - A1) / (A2 + A1).

expression.label: Expression
expression.description: A NumPy expression over A, B, C (and A1, A2, …). Functions: where, log, exp, sqrt, abs, clip, minimum, maximum, sin, cos, tan.

b_path.label: Raster B (optional)
b_path.description: A second raster, referenced as B / B1, B2, …. Must match A's dimensions.

c_path.label: Raster C (optional)
c_path.description: A third raster, referenced as C / C1, C2, …. Must match A's dimensions.

spectral-index.name: Spectral index
spectral-index.description: Compute a named spectral index (NDVI, NDWI, EVI, …) from a multiband raster. Pick a sensor preset for the band layout, or set band numbers manually with the Custom sensor.

sensor.label: Sensor / band layout
sensor.description: Preset band numbers for common sensors. Choose Custom to map bands by hand for a differently stacked GeoTIFF.

options.sentinel2: Sentinel-2 (B2, B3, B4, B8, B11, B12)

L.label: Soil factor (L)
L.description: SAVI soil-brightness correction (0 dense cover → 1 bare soil).

scale.label: Reflectance scale
scale.description: Multiplier converting pixel values to reflectance (0–1). Leave at 1 for normalized-difference indices; set it for EVI/SAVI on integer-DN imagery (e.g. 0.0001 for Sentinel-2 L2A).

reclassify.name: Reclassify
reclassify.description: Remap value ranges to new class values using a rule table.

table.label: Rules
table.description: Comma- or newline-separated 'min:max:newvalue' rules, e.g. '0:10:1, 10:20:2, 20:max:3'. Ranges are half-open [min, max); blank/min/max mean ±∞.

mosaic.name: Mosaic / merge
mosaic.description: Combine up to five rasters (sharing a CRS) into a single raster covering their union.

method.label: Overlap method
method.description: Which value wins where inputs overlap.

focal.name: Focal statistics
focal.description: Apply a moving-window (neighbourhood) statistic to a raster band.

size.label: Window size
size.description: Odd neighbourhood size in pixels (3 = 3×3). Capped at 25.

features.description: Input object-features CSV (must include segment_id and numeric feature columns).

class_field.description: Class label field in training CSV (default class).

palette.label: Palette

clipping_polygon.label: Clipping Polygon
clipping_polygon.description: Optional polygon vector path; only DEM cells inside polygon(s) are rendered.

background_hgt_offset.label: Background Hgt Offset
background_hgt_offset.description: Vertical offset from minimum DEM elevation to background plane.

z_factor.label: Z Factor
z_factor.description: Vertical exaggeration multiplier.

max_dist.label: Max Dist
max_dist.description: Maximum shadow search distance in map units.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output raster path.

add_surface_information.name: Add Surface Information
add_surface_information.description: Append per-feature surface statistics from an elevation raster — Z, 3D surface length, 3D surface area, min/max/mean Z, and min/max/avg slope — as attribute fields without altering the input geometry, like ArcGIS Add Surface Information.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer (points, lines, or polygons) sharing the surface's CRS.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector path (driver from extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

properties.label: Properties
properties.description: Comma list of surface property groups to append: Z, SURFACE_LENGTH, SURFACE_AREA, MIN_MAX_MEAN_Z, MIN_MAX_AVG_SLOPE. Default: all applicable to the layer's geometry.

sample_distance.label: Sample Distance
sample_distance.description: Densification interval in CRS units for line/perimeter sampling; long segments are split so they follow the surface. Default: the raster cell size.

add_z_information.name: Add Z Information
add_z_information.description: Appends Z-derived geometry statistics to 3D features — spot/min/max/mean Z, 3D length, mesh surface area and volume, slope statistics and vertex counts (ArcGIS Add Z Information). vector_summary_statistics and attribute_histogram summarise attributes rather than geometry, and polygon_volume / surface_volume measure a raster against a reference plane, so nothing currently annotates a 3D vector feature from its own Z.

input.label: Input
input.description: 3D point, line, polygon or multipatch features. Note that a Z of zero is indistinguishable from an absent Z, so 'features_with_z' is a hint rather than a guarantee.

output.label: Output
output.description: Input features with the requested fields appended. If omitted, stored in memory.

properties.label: Properties
properties.description: Comma-separated subset of spot_z, min_z, max_z, mean_z, length_3d, surface_area, volume, min_slope, max_slope, mean_slope, point_count, vertex_count. Default: all of them (fields not applicable to a geometry are left null).

noise_filtering.label: Noise Filtering
noise_filtering.description: Percentage (0-50) trimmed from each end of the Z distribution before min_z / max_z, so a single spike vertex does not define the reported extremes. Default 0.

adjust_3d_z.name: Adjust 3D Z
adjust_3d_z.description: Apply a Z-unit conversion, vertical offset, and/or multiplicative factor to the Z ordinates of 3D features.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer (features should carry Z ordinates).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path. If omitted, the result is stored in memory.

factor.label: Factor
factor.description: Multiplicative factor applied to Z (default 1.0). Useful for vertical exaggeration or a datum scale.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Additive vertical offset applied after the factor, in target units (default 0.0).

from_unit.label: From Unit
from_unit.description: Source Z unit preset (meters, feet, us_feet, centimeters, millimeters, kilometers, miles, yards, inches). Requires to_unit.

to_unit.label: To Unit
to_unit.description: Target Z unit preset. Requires from_unit. Z is scaled by (meters-per-from_unit / meters-per-to_unit).

adjust_stream_to_raster.name: Adjust Stream To Raster
adjust_stream_to_raster.description: Move stream polyline vertices onto the flow path implied by a DEM so vector hydrography and the elevation surface agree, by snapping nodes to high-accumulation cells and tracing the D8 pointer chain between them. The inverse of stream burning. Like ArcGIS Adjust Stream To Raster.

input.label: Input
input.description: Stream polyline features to adjust.

dem.label: Dem
dem.description: Surface raster defining the true flow path.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output adjusted stream path. If omitted, stored in memory.

snap_distance.label: Snap Distance
snap_distance.description: Search radius in map units for snapping nodes to a high-accumulation cell (default: 5 cells).

channel_threshold.label: Channel Threshold
channel_threshold.description: Flow-accumulation value (in cells) at or above which a cell counts as channelised for snapping (default: 1% of the DEM's maximum accumulation).

remove_disconnected.label: Remove Disconnected
remove_disconnected.description: Drop lines that cannot be routed at all (default true). When false they are passed through unchanged and flagged.

output_stream_raster.label: Output Stream Raster
output_stream_raster.description: Optional raster marking the adjusted stream cells.

output_flow_direction.label: Output Flow Direction
output_flow_direction.description: Optional D8 pointer raster derived from the DEM.

output_split_points.label: Output Split Points
output_split_points.description: Optional points where the pointer trace failed and a least-cost fallback was used.

aggregate_multidimensional_raster.name: Aggregate Multidimensional Raster
aggregate_multidimensional_raster.description: Bins the slices of a raster cube along its dimension and reduces each bin to one output band — daily scenes into monthly composites, a decade into annual means (ArcGIS Aggregate Multidimensional Raster). Round 17's cell_statistics reduces a stack only to a single layer and has no notion of a dimension, while round 16's multidimensional_anomaly performs the opposite operation and preserves the slice count.

input.label: Input
input.description: One multiband raster (each band is a slice) or a comma-separated list of co-registered rasters.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output multiband raster, one band per bin. If omitted, stored in memory.

dimension.label: Dimension
dimension.description: Name of the dimension, used only in the report (default 'slice').

dimension_values.label: Dimension Values
dimension_values.description: Comma-separated coordinate of each slice, strictly increasing. Defaults to the 1-based slice index.

interval_value.label: Interval Value
interval_value.description: Bin width in dimension units, for 'interval_value'.

ignore_nodata.label: Ignore Nodata
ignore_nodata.description: Skip no-data slices per cell (default true). When false, one no-data slice makes the whole bin no-data at that cell.

aggregate_points.name: Aggregate Points
aggregate_points.description: Group points that fall within an aggregation distance of each other into cluster polygons (convex hull or buffered union), each carrying a point count and optional per-cluster field sums, like ArcGIS Aggregate Points.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input point vector layer (Point or MultiPoint).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output polygon vector path (driver from extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

aggregation_distance.label: Aggregation Distance
aggregation_distance.description: Maximum distance between points for them to join the same cluster (map units).

min_points.label: Min Points
min_points.description: Minimum points a cluster needs to be output (default 2; set 1 to keep singletons).

sum_fields.label: Sum Fields
sum_fields.description: Comma-separated numeric fields to sum per cluster (output columns 'sum_<field>').

aggregate_polygons.name: Aggregate Polygons
aggregate_polygons.description: Combine polygons within an aggregation distance into larger polygons (morphological closing), with minimum-area and minimum-hole-size filters and an optional barrier layer aggregation may not cross.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input polygon vector layer, format auto-detected (or in-memory handle).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (driver from its extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

aggregation_distance.label: Aggregation Distance
aggregation_distance.description: Polygons within this distance (CRS units) of each other are aggregated. Sets the morphological-closing radius to half this value.

min_area.label: Min Area
min_area.description: Drop aggregated polygons whose area (CRS units squared) is below this value. Default: keep all.

min_hole_size.label: Min Hole Size
min_hole_size.description: Fill interior holes whose area (CRS units squared) is below this value. Default: keep all holes.

barrier.label: Barrier
barrier.description: Optional barrier vector layer (lines or polygons) that aggregation may not cross; bridges spanning a barrier are severed. Existing input polygons are never split.

align_features.name: Align Features
align_features.description: Conform source line/polygon edges to a nearby trusted target layer within a search distance, pulling whole edge runs (not just endpoints) with a smooth taper and coincident shared boundaries, like ArcGIS Align Features.

input.label: Input
input.description: Source vector layer to align (lines or polygons).

target.label: Target
target.description: Trusted target layer (lines, or polygon boundaries) that source vertices are pulled toward.

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (driver from extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

search_distance.label: Search Distance
search_distance.description: Max distance (CRS units) a source vertex may be pulled toward the target. Required.

match_field.label: Match Field
match_field.description: Optional source attribute field; only target edges whose target_match_field value matches are candidates for that feature's vertices.

target_match_field.label: Target Match Field
target_match_field.description: Target attribute field compared against match_field. Defaults to match_field's name if omitted; requires match_field.

analyze_changes_ccdc.name: Analyze Changes Using CCDC
analyze_changes_ccdc.description: CCDC continuous change detection on a dense image time series (like ArcGIS Analyze Changes Using CCDC): per-pixel harmonic (seasonal) OLS regression, then a sliding residual test (k×RMSE, min consecutive anomalies) that declares breaks and refits segments. Emits break-count, first-break-date, and initial-segment RMSE/slope/amplitude rasters — the seasonal, multi-break change history the yearly landtrendr and two-date change_vector_analysis can't produce.

input.label: Input
input.description: A single multiband raster (each band is a time slice) OR a comma-separated list of co-registered single-band raster paths, in time order.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output break-count raster (breaks detected per pixel). If omitted, stored in memory.

dates.label: Dates
dates.description: Comma-separated numeric dates (decimal years or day numbers) matching the slices. Default 0,1,2,...

period.label: Period
period.description: Length of one seasonal cycle in the units of 'dates' (default 1.0 for decimal years; use 365 for day numbers).

harmonic_order.label: Harmonic Order
harmonic_order.description: Number of sine/cosine harmonic pairs at the annual frequency (default 1 = annual only; 2 adds the semi-annual term).

change_threshold.label: Change Threshold
change_threshold.description: Anomaly threshold as a multiple k of the segment RMSE (default 3.0). A residual > k×RMSE flags an observation.

min_consecutive.label: Min Consecutive
min_consecutive.description: Number of consecutive flagged observations required to declare a break (default 3).

min_observations.label: Min Observations
min_observations.description: Minimum valid observations used to initialize a segment's harmonic model (default 12). Pixels with fewer valid observations become no-data.

band.label: Band
band.description: For a comma-separated list input: 1-based band to read from each raster (default 1). Ignored for a single multiband input.

break_date_output.label: Break Date Output
break_date_output.description: Optional raster of the date of the first detected break per pixel (no-data where no break).

rmse_output.label: Rmse Output
rmse_output.description: Optional raster of the initial-segment harmonic model RMSE.

slope_output.label: Slope Output
slope_output.description: Optional raster of the initial-segment linear trend (slope) coefficient.

amplitude_output.label: Amplitude Output
amplitude_output.description: Optional raster of the initial-segment first-harmonic amplitude sqrt(a²+b²).

apply_radiometric_calibration.name: Apply Radiometric Calibration
apply_radiometric_calibration.description: Converts raw SAR digital numbers into calibrated backscatter — beta nought, sigma nought or gamma nought — so acquisitions become physically comparable and published thresholds apply (ArcGIS Apply Radiometric Calibration). Nothing in either registry does this: rescale_value_range is a linear stretch with no radiometric meaning, and multilook, sar_coherence, the Lee speckle filters and compute_sar_indices all consume whatever values they are handed.

input.label: Input
input.description: SAR raster in digital numbers, amplitude, intensity or dB (see 'input_units').

output.label: Output
output.description: Output calibrated backscatter raster. If omitted, stored in memory.

calibration_constant.label: Calibration Constant
calibration_constant.description: Sensor calibration constant A (default 1.0). Ignored when 'calibration_lut' is given.

calibration_lut.label: Calibration Lut
calibration_lut.description: Optional co-registered raster of per-cell calibration constants A, overriding 'calibration_constant'.

incidence_angle.label: Incidence Angle
incidence_angle.description: Local incidence angle in degrees: a constant, or a co-registered raster path. Required for 'sigma0' and 'gamma0'.

input_units.label: Input Units
input_units.description: 'dn' (default), 'amplitude', 'intensity', or 'db'. dn and amplitude are squared to power; db is delinearised first.

apportion_polygon.name: Apportion Polygon
apportion_polygon.description: Transfer numeric attributes from a source polygon layer onto a target polygon layer, apportioned by area of overlap (dasymetric reaggregation between zone systems), like ArcGIS Apportion Polygon.

target.label: Target
target.description: Target polygon layer (receives the apportioned values; its features and attributes are preserved).

source.label: Source
source.description: Source polygon layer carrying the values to distribute.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated numeric field name(s) on the source to apportion.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector path (a copy of the target with apportioned columns). If omitted, stored in memory.

method.label: Method
method.description: 'area' (default; split by overlap area) or 'weight' (split by overlap area times the target 'weight_field').

weight_field.label: Weight Field
weight_field.description: Target numeric field used as an extra weight when method=weight.

suffix.label: Suffix
suffix.description: Suffix for the apportioned output columns. Default '_app'.

areal_interpolation.name: Areal Interpolation
areal_interpolation.description: Predicts aggregated values for target polygons from source polygons with a different geography, by fitting a smooth underlying surface and re-integrating it rather than weighting by area (ArcGIS Areal Interpolation Layer To Polygons). apportion_polygon assumes the quantity is uniform inside each source polygon — the classic modifiable-areal-unit-problem failure — and gives no standard errors; the bundled kriging suite is entirely point-support and cannot accept polygon observations.

input.label: Input
input.description: Source polygons carrying the measured field.

target.label: Target
target.description: Target polygons to predict values for.

field.label: Field
field.description: Numeric value field on the source polygons.

output.label: Output
output.description: Target polygons with PREDICTED, PRED_STD_ERR and the diagnostics appended. If omitted, stored in memory.

field_type.label: Field Type
field_type.description: 'count' (default): an extensive total, rescaled to preserve the source sum. 'average': an intensive mean, predicted directly with no rescaling.

discretization.label: Discretization
discretization.description: Approximate number of interior points used to represent each polygon's area support (default 25). Higher is more accurate and much slower.

preserve_total.label: Preserve Total
preserve_total.description: Rescale count predictions so the target total matches the source total (default true for 'count', always off for 'average'). Only applied when the targets cover the sources — the applied factor is reported as 'mass_scale' so a partial-coverage run is visible.

attribute_uncertainty.name: Attribute Uncertainty
attribute_uncertainty.description: Seeded Monte-Carlo error propagation over an uncertain attribute (like ArcGIS Attribute Uncertainty): draw NORMAL/UNIFORM realizations from a per-feature error field or bound pair and append mean/std/p5/p50/p95/CV statistics.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer (or table) with the uncertain attribute.

value_field.label: Value Field
value_field.description: Numeric field holding the estimate (distribution mean/center) for each feature.

error_field.label: Error Field
error_field.description: Numeric field holding the symmetric uncertainty: a standard error for NORMAL, or a half-width for UNIFORM. Provide this OR both lower_field/upper_field.

lower_field.label: Lower Field
lower_field.description: Numeric field with the lower bound of the value. Use together with upper_field instead of error_field.

upper_field.label: Upper Field
upper_field.description: Numeric field with the upper bound of the value. Use together with lower_field instead of error_field.

iterations.label: Iterations
iterations.description: Number of Monte-Carlo realizations per feature (default 1000).

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the deterministic RNG (default 1).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector layer with the appended statistics. If omitted, stored in memory.

band_collection_statistics.name: Band Collection Statistics
band_collection_statistics.description: Per-band min/max/mean/std plus the cross-band covariance and correlation matrices for a raster stack (like ArcGIS Band Collection Statistics) — the multivariate summary (PCA / classification precursor) the bundled suite lacks; distinct from per-pixel cell_statistics.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: One multiband raster (each band is a layer) or a comma-separated list of co-registered rasters.

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional CSV path for the statistics report. The matrices are always returned in the result.

detail.label: Detail
detail.description: 'detailed' (default) includes covariance/correlation matrices; 'brief' returns per-band statistics only.

bivariate_spatial_association.name: Bivariate Spatial Association
bivariate_spatial_association.description: Lee's L global and local statistic measuring where two continuous variables co-vary spatially, with a seeded permutation-test p-value and a High-High/High-Low/Low-High/Low-Low class per feature — like ArcGIS Bivariate Spatial Association. The continuous-field counterpart of colocation_analysis.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer with two numeric fields.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output layer with local L, p-value, and class fields. If omitted, stored in memory.

neighbors.label: Neighbors
neighbors.description: Number of nearest neighbours for the spatial weights (default 8).

permutations.label: Permutations
permutations.description: Number of permutations for the significance test (default 199; 0 disables).

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the permutation RNG (default 1), for reproducible results.

block_statistics.name: Block Statistics
block_statistics.description: Partitions a raster into non-overlapping blocks, reduces each by a statistic, and writes that value back to every cell in the block at the input resolution (ArcGIS Block Statistics). Complements the shipped focal_statistics (overlapping window), zonal_statistics (by zone layer) and cell_statistics (across a stack); unlike the bundled aggregate_raster it preserves cell size, so input - block mean gives a local residual surface, and it adds the categorical statistics majority/minority/median/variety.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input raster.

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output raster path. If omitted, the result is stored in memory.

statistic.label: Statistic
statistic.description: One of mean (default), majority, maximum, median, minimum, minority, range, std, sum, variety.

neighborhood.label: Neighborhood
neighborhood.description: Block shape: rectangle (default), circle, annulus, or wedge.

size.label: Size
size.description: Block dimensions in cells: 'width,height' for rectangle (default '3,3'), 'radius' for circle/wedge, or 'inner,outer' for annulus.

start_angle.label: Start Angle
start_angle.description: Wedge start angle in degrees counter-clockwise from east (default 0).

end_angle.label: End Angle
end_angle.description: Wedge end angle in degrees counter-clockwise from east (default 90).

ignore_nodata.label: Ignore Nodata
ignore_nodata.description: If true (default), blocks are computed from valid cells only; if false, any no-data cell makes the whole block no-data.

boundary_clean.name: Boundary Clean
boundary_clean.description: Smooth categorical raster zone boundaries and remove speckle via majority filtering or expand/shrink boundary cleaning, the standard cleanup before polygonization — like ArcGIS Boundary Clean / Majority Filter.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input categorical (integer-valued) raster.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output raster path. If omitted, stored in memory.

method.label: Method
method.description: 'majority' (neighbour-majority speckle removal; default) or 'expand_shrink' (Boundary Clean smoothing).

threshold.label: Threshold
threshold.description: majority mode only: 'majority' (strict majority of neighbours; default) or 'half' (at least half).

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: expand_shrink mode only: zone priority by cell count — 'descending' (larger zones win; default), 'ascending' (smaller zones win), or 'none'.

buffer_3d.name: Buffer 3D
buffer_3d.description: Buffer 3D points and lines into volumetric geometry (spheres and capsules) emitted as a triangulated surface, like ArcGIS Buffer 3D.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input 3D point or polyline layer (missing Z is treated as 0).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output path. If omitted, the result is stored in memory.

shape.label: Shape
shape.description: round (default; hemispherical caps) or flat (cylinder with flat caps).

quality.label: Quality
quality.description: Tessellation resolution: segments around the circumference (default 12, min 4, max 64).

buffer_vector.name: Buffer Vector
buffer_vector.description: Extends geometries by a specified distance, creating polygon buffers with customizable cap/join styles. Optional dissolve merges overlapping buffers into unified polygons.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer.

quadrant_segments.label: Quadrant Segments
quadrant_segments.description: Arc resolution in segments per quadrant; defaults to 8.

cap_style.label: Cap Style
cap_style.description: Line end-cap style: round, flat, or square.

join_style.label: Join Style
join_style.description: Corner join style: round, bevel, or mitre.

mitre_limit.label: Mitre Limit
mitre_limit.description: Mitre join limit used when join_style=mitre; defaults to 5.0.

dissolve.label: Dissolve
dissolve.description: Dissolve overlapping buffers into a single unified polygon; defaults to false.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector path.

build_balanced_zones.name: Build Balanced Zones
build_balanced_zones.description: Group contiguous polygons into a target number of connected zones that balance feature count, an attribute sum, or attribute homogeneity, using SKATER spanning-tree partitioning.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input polygon layer, format auto-detected (or in-memory handle).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (driver from its extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

zones.label: Zones
zones.description: Target number of zones to create.

criterion.label: Criterion
criterion.description: Balance objective: 'homogeneity' (default), 'equal_count', or 'equal_sum' (of the first field).

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated numeric analysis field(s). Required for 'homogeneity' and 'equal_sum'; drives the spanning-tree edge weights.

contiguity.label: Contiguity
contiguity.description: Adjacency rule: 'rook' (shared edge, default) or 'queen' (shared edge or vertex).

tolerance.label: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Maximum distance for two boundary segments to count as shared (rook). Default 1e-6.

build_seamlines.name: Build Seamlines
build_seamlines.description: Given a set of overlapping rasters (and optional footprints), compute where each image should be cut so the mosaic joins along a minimally visible seam, emitting one non-overlapping seamline polygon per image via a Voronoi, priority-order, radiometric or edge-aware assignment. Like ArcGIS Build Seamlines.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: Comma/semicolon-separated raster paths to mosaic.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output seamline polygon path (one feature per input raster). If omitted, stored in memory.

footprints.label: Footprints
footprints.description: Optional polygon layer giving each raster's valid extent, in input order. Derived from valid data when omitted.

sort_ascending.label: Sort Ascending
sort_ascending.description: For method 'order': true (default) gives earlier rasters priority, false gives later ones priority.

cell_size.label: Cell Size
cell_size.description: Analysis cell size (default: the finest input cell size).

band.label: Band
band.description: 1-based band used for the radiometric methods (default 1).

min_region_size.label: Min Region Size
min_region_size.description: Reassign assigned regions smaller than this many cells to a neighbouring image (default 0, i.e. keep all).

blend_width.label: Blend Width
blend_width.description: Feather width in map units, written as an attribute for downstream mosaicking (default 0).

calculate_adjacent_fields.name: Calculate Adjacent Fields
calculate_adjacent_fields.description: Populate eight directional neighbour-sheet fields (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW) on each tile of a map-series index grid with the adjoining page's name, for 'continued on sheet …' margin labels — like ArcGIS Calculate Adjacent Fields.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input polygon map-series index grid (e.g. output of grid_index_features).

page_name_field.label: Page Name Field
page_name_field.description: Field whose value labels each page (written into the neighbours' directional fields).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output polygon vector (driver from extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

include_diagonal.label: Include Diagonal
include_diagonal.description: Also populate the four diagonal fields (NE, SE, SW, NW) from corner-touching tiles. Default true.

snap_tolerance.label: Snap Tolerance
snap_tolerance.description: Quantize vertices onto a grid of this size (CRS units) before matching borders. Default 0 (exact coordinates).

calculate_central_meridian_and_parallels.name: Calculate Central Meridian And Parallels
calculate_central_meridian_and_parallels.description: Compute a per-feature central meridian and two standard parallels from each feature's extent, for map-series and atlas pages, like ArcGIS Calculate Central Meridian And Parallels.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input features in geographic coordinates (longitude/latitude), typically a grid_index_features page grid.

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output path. If omitted, the result is stored in memory.

field.label: Field
field.description: Name of the central-meridian field to write (default 'central_meridian').

standard_offset.label: Standard Offset
standard_offset.description: Fraction of the latitude range used to inset each standard parallel from the feature's edge (default 0.1667, Esri's 1/6 rule). Must be in [0, 0.5).

calculate_composite_index.name: Calculate Composite Index
calculate_composite_index.description: Combine several numeric attributes into a composite index (like ArcGIS Calculate Composite Index): per-variable scaling (min-max/z-score/percentile) with optional reversal, weighted combination (mean/sum/geometric mean), and output rescaling — the vector-side sibling of fuzzy_overlay.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer (or table) with numeric variable fields.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated variable fields; append ':reverse' to a field whose high values should lower the index (e.g. 'income:reverse,unemployment').

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector layer with the index fields added. If omitted, stored in memory.

combine.label: Combine
combine.description: How to combine scaled variables: 'mean' (default), 'sum', or 'geometric_mean'.

output_range.label: Output Range
output_range.description: Rescale the combined index: 'minmax' (0–1, default), 'zero_to_100', 'zscore', or 'none'.

calculate_distance_band.name: Calculate Distance Band
calculate_distance_band.description: Report the minimum, average, and maximum distance at which every feature has at least N neighbours (like ArcGIS Calculate Distance Band from Neighbor Count) — the threshold diagnostic that guarantees no feature is left with zero neighbours before distance-based spatial stats. The bundled generate_spatial_weights_matrix builds the matrix but never reports this band.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input point/feature vector layer (projected CRS; distances in its units).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional CSV path for a feature_id,kth_neighbor_distance table.

calculate_end_time.name: Calculate End Time
calculate_end_time.description: Fills an end-time field from the start time of the next record within each entity group, turning instant-in-time observations into time-extent records (ArcGIS Calculate End Time). transform_fields does per-value transforms and summary_statistics aggregates groups, but nothing performed a row-ordered temporal fill.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer or table.

start_field.label: Start Field
start_field.description: Timestamp field: a numeric epoch, or an ISO-8601 date/date-time string.

end_field.label: End Field
end_field.description: Field receiving the end time (default 'END_TIME'). Created if absent, overwritten if present.

id_fields.label: Id Fields
id_fields.description: Comma- or semicolon-separated grouping fields. End times are derived within a group only, never across group boundaries.

last_record.label: Last Record
last_record.description: What to write for each group's final row: 'null' (default), 'same_as_start', or 'duration' (start + default_duration).

default_duration.label: Default Duration
default_duration.description: Seconds added to the start for last_record 'duration'.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output layer. If omitted, stored in memory.

calculate_grid_convergence_angle.name: Calculate Grid Convergence Angle
calculate_grid_convergence_angle.description: Compute, per feature, the grid convergence angle between grid north and true north from the centroid lon/lat and a central meridian (default the feature's own UTM central meridian), writing it to a field for correct symbol/label rotation on projected maps — like ArcGIS Calculate Grid Convergence Angle. Geographic (clockwise from north) or arithmetic (counter-clockwise from east) convention. Pure math, no PROJ; unrelated to the bundled convergence_index terrain metric. Geometry is read as lon/lat degrees.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer (any geometry type) in geographic coordinates (lon/lat degrees, EPSG:4326).

angle_field.label: Angle Field
angle_field.description: Name of the float field to hold the convergence angle in degrees. Default 'GRID_CONV'.

angle_type.label: Angle Type
angle_type.description: Angle convention: 'geographic' (degrees clockwise from north, positive east) or 'arithmetic' (degrees counter-clockwise from east, 90 − geographic). Default 'geographic'.

central_meridian.label: Central Meridian
central_meridian.description: Central meridian longitude in degrees. If omitted, each feature uses its own UTM-zone central meridian derived from its longitude.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector path (driver from extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

calculate_missing_z_values.name: Calculate Missing Z Values
calculate_missing_z_values.description: Fill placeholder or absent Z values along 3D features by interpolating from the valid Z values on either side, like ArcGIS Calculate Missing Z Values.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input feature layer with 3D vertices.

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output path. If omitted, the result is stored in memory.

placeholder.label: Placeholder
placeholder.description: Sentinel value marking a missing Z (e.g. -9999). Vertices with no Z at all are always treated as missing.

method.label: Method
method.description: Fill method: 'linear' (default; interpolate by distance along the feature) or 'nearest'.

extrapolate.label: Extrapolate
extrapolate.description: Fill leading/trailing gaps by extending the nearest valid vertex (default false; unfilled vertices are counted instead).

calculate_motion_statistics.name: Calculate Motion Statistics
calculate_motion_statistics.description: Annotate timestamped track points with motion statistics — speed, acceleration, bearing, segment and cumulative distance, elapsed time and idle flag — grouped by track and ordered by time, like ArcGIS Calculate Motion Statistics.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input point vector layer of timestamped observations.

time_field.label: Time Field
time_field.description: Field holding each point's time: numeric seconds or an ISO-8601 timestamp.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output point vector (original attributes + motion fields). If omitted, stored in memory.

window.label: Window
window.description: Trailing number of points for the smoothed 'avg_speed' (default 1 = instantaneous).

idle_distance.label: Idle Distance
idle_distance.description: Idle radius: a point is idle when the mover travelled no more than this over the last idle_duration seconds. Default 0 (idle detection off).

idle_duration.label: Idle Duration
idle_duration.description: Look-back window (seconds) for idle detection. Default 60.

calculate_polygon_main_angle.name: Calculate Polygon Main Angle
calculate_polygon_main_angle.description: Write each polygon's dominant orientation (the long-side direction of its minimum-area bounding rectangle, via rotating calipers) to an angle field — like ArcGIS Calculate Polygon Main Angle. The per-polygon vector orientation the bundled raster-only patch_orientation lacks; feeds symbol/label rotation.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input polygon layer.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output polygon layer with the angle field added. If omitted, stored in memory.

angle_field.label: Angle Field
angle_field.description: Name of the angle field to write (default 'MainAngle').

convention.label: Convention
convention.description: 'arithmetic' (CCW from east; default), 'geographic' (CW from north), or 'graphic' (CW from east).

calculate_rates.name: Calculate Rates
calculate_rates.description: Compute smoothed rates from count and population fields (like ArcGIS Calculate Rates): crude rate, Marshall global empirical Bayes, or spatial empirical Bayes over k-nearest neighbours — the standard stabilization step before hot-spot analysis of disease/crime rates.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input polygon or point layer with count and population fields.

population_field.label: Population Field
population_field.description: Field holding the population at risk (denominator).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output layer with rate fields added. If omitted, stored in memory.

neighbors.label: Neighbors
neighbors.description: eb_spatial only: number of nearest neighbours for the local reference rate (default 8).

calculate_transformation_errors.name: Calculate Transformation Errors
calculate_transformation_errors.description: Fit a similarity/affine/projective transformation from displacement links and report each link's residual error plus the overall RMSE, so bad control points can be found and removed before transforming. Like ArcGIS Calculate Transformation Errors.

input.label: Input
input.description: Displacement link lines: first vertex is the source (from) point, last vertex the target (to) point.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output path for the link table with residual fields appended. If omitted, stored in memory.

keep_geometry.label: Keep Geometry
keep_geometry.description: Keep each link's geometry on the output (default true). Set false for a pure table.

calculate_transit_service_frequency.name: Calculate Transit Service Frequency
calculate_transit_service_frequency.description: Windowed GTFS transit service frequency: for a service date (via calendar/calendar_dates) and time window, count trips serving each stop or route line and report trips-per-hour, like ArcGIS Calculate Transit Service Frequency.

input.label: Input
input.description: Path to an extracted GTFS feed directory.

target.label: Target
target.description: 'stops' (point per stop, default) or 'lines' (polyline per route).

date.label: Date
date.description: Service date YYYYMMDD, resolved via calendar.txt/calendar_dates.txt. If omitted, all services count.

start_time.label: Start Time
start_time.description: Window start HH:MM or HH:MM:SS (GTFS times may exceed 24:00). If omitted, the whole day counts.

duration_minutes.label: Duration Minutes
duration_minutes.description: Window length in minutes (used with start_time; also sets the per-hour denominator).

count.label: Count
count.description: 'departures' (default) or 'arrivals' — which stop-time field to count.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector path (driver from extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

calculate_utm_zone.name: Calculate UTM Zone
calculate_utm_zone.description: Compute the optimal UTM zone and WGS84 EPSG code for each feature from its centroid longitude/latitude, adding a zone (1–60) and an EPSG (326##/327##) field — for adaptive-projection map series, like ArcGIS Calculate UTM Zone. Pure math with the Norway/Svalbard exceptions; no PROJ. Geometry is read as lon/lat degrees.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer (any geometry type) in geographic coordinates (lon/lat degrees, EPSG:4326).

zone_field.label: Zone Field
zone_field.description: Name of the integer field to hold the UTM zone number (1–60). Default 'utm_zone'.

epsg_field.label: Epsg Field
epsg_field.description: Name of the integer field to hold the WGS84 UTM EPSG code (326## north, 327## south). Default 'utm_epsg'.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector path (driver from extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

cartogram.name: Cartogram
cartogram.description: Distort polygons so area is proportional to an attribute value: non-contiguous (scale each polygon about its centroid) or Dorling (proportional circles with overlap removal).

input.label: Input
input.description: Input polygon vector layer, format auto-detected (or in-memory handle).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (driver from its extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

value_field.label: Value Field
value_field.description: Numeric field whose value each feature's area should be proportional to.

method.label: Method
method.description: 'non_contiguous' (default; scale polygons in place) or 'dorling' (proportional circles).

iterations.label: Iterations
iterations.description: Dorling overlap-removal iterations (default 100). Ignored by non_contiguous.

causal_inference_analysis.name: Causal Inference Analysis
causal_inference_analysis.description: Estimate the causal effect of a binary treatment on an outcome via propensity-score matching, inverse-probability weighting, or regression adjustment, with a seeded bootstrap CI and a per-confounder covariate-balance table before/after adjustment (like ArcGIS Causal Inference Analysis).

input.label: Input
input.description: Input feature layer.

treatment_field.label: Treatment Field
treatment_field.description: Binary (0/1, or boolean) treatment field. Continuous treatments are not supported in this version.

confounding_fields.label: Confounding Fields
confounding_fields.description: Comma-separated numeric confounder field(s) to adjust for.

method.label: Method
method.description: 'ps_matching' (default, nearest-neighbour caliper matching on the propensity score), 'ipw' (stabilized inverse-probability weighting), or 'regression_adjustment' (outcome ~ treatment + confounders).

add_spatial_confounders.label: Add Spatial Confounders
add_spatial_confounders.description: If true, widen the confounder set with each feature's x/y coordinates plus the k-nearest-neighbour average of each confounder (default false).

balance_threshold.label: Balance Threshold
balance_threshold.description: Standardized-mean-difference threshold for the post-adjustment balance check (default 0.1).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (input copy + propensity score / weight / match-id columns). If omitted, stored in memory.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Integer seed for the deterministic bootstrap confidence interval (default 42).

cell_position_statistics.name: Cell Position Statistics
cell_position_statistics.description: Per-cell position and rank statistics across a stack of aligned rasters (ArcGIS Highest Position, Lowest Position, Popularity and Rank): which layer holds the extreme value, the value occurring a given number of times, or the nth-smallest value. cell_statistics reduces a stack to a value and can never report which layer that value came from, and the bundled find_argument_statistics works along one multiband raster's argument axis without the popularity/rank selector semantics.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: One multiband raster (each band is a layer) or a comma-separated list of co-registered rasters.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output raster. If omitted, stored in memory.

selector.label: Selector
selector.description: Required for 'popularity' and 'rank': a co-registered raster path, or a constant number, giving the per-cell occurrence count (popularity) or 1-based rank to select.

ignore_nodata.label: Ignore Nodata
ignore_nodata.description: Skip no-data observations per cell (default true). When false, any no-data observation makes the cell no-data.

process_as_multiband.label: Process As Multiband
process_as_multiband.description: 'single_band' (default): every band of every input is one layer of a single stack. 'multi_band': band i of every input forms its own stack, giving a multiband result.

cell_records_to_sectors.name: Cell Records To Sectors
cell_records_to_sectors.description: Build antenna coverage geometry from cell-tower points: wedge polygons or bisector sector lines from per-tower azimuth, beamwidth, and radius — like ArcGIS Cell Site Records To Feature Class / Generate Sector Lines.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input point vector layer of antennas/towers.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector path (driver from extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

output_type.label: Output Type
output_type.description: Geometry to emit: 'wedge' (coverage polygons, default) or 'line' (bisector sector lines).

azimuth_field.label: Azimuth Field
azimuth_field.description: Field holding each antenna's azimuth (compass degrees, 0 = north, clockwise). Falls back to 'azimuth' when missing.

beamwidth_field.label: Beamwidth Field
beamwidth_field.description: Field holding each antenna's beamwidth in degrees. Falls back to 'beamwidth' when missing.

radius_field.label: Radius Field
radius_field.description: Field holding each antenna's coverage radius in CRS units. Falls back to 'radius' when missing.

azimuth.label: Azimuth
azimuth.description: Default azimuth in compass degrees when no field is given / a value is missing. Default 0.

beamwidth.label: Beamwidth
beamwidth.description: Default beamwidth in degrees (0 < bw ≤ 360; ≥ 360 = omnidirectional). Default 65.

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: Default coverage radius in CRS units (must be positive). Default 1000.

segments.label: Segments
segments.description: Number of straight segments used to approximate each sector arc (≥ 1). Default 16.

cell_statistics.name: Cell Statistics
cell_statistics.description: Per-pixel statistic across a stack of aligned rasters (like ArcGIS Cell Statistics): mean, majority, maximum, median, minimum, minority, percentile, range, std, sum, or variety — the local multi-raster reducer the bundled sum_overlay/weighted_sum (sum only) and the neighbourhood/zonal tools don't provide.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: One multiband raster (each band is a layer) or a comma-separated list of co-registered rasters.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output single-band raster of the reduced value. If omitted, stored in memory.

ignore_nodata.label: Ignore Nodata
ignore_nodata.description: Skip no-data observations per cell (default true). When false, any no-data observation makes the cell no-data.
