Output is a pure attribute table. No case field yields a single grand-total row (like ArcGIS's Summary Statistics; count-only reproduces Frequency).

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer or attribute table to aggregate.

statistics.label: Statistics
statistics.description: Semicolon/comma-separated list of 'field statistic' pairs (also accepts 'field:statistic'), e.g. 'population sum; population mean; elev max'. Statistics: count, sum, mean, min, max, std, first, last.

case_fields.label: Case Fields
case_fields.description: Optional comma/semicolon-separated case (GROUP BY) field name(s). If omitted, a single summary row is produced over the whole table.

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output table path (driver from its extension; GeoParquet or CSV). If omitted, the table is stored in memory. Columns: the case fields, a record 'count', then one '<field>_<statistic>' column per requested pair.

sun_shadow_volume.name: Sun Shadow Volume
sun_shadow_volume.description: Extrudes 3D solids along the solar vector to the ground to produce closed shadow-volume solids for a given date and time (ArcGIS Sun Shadow Volume). shadow_image, shadow_animation and time_in_daylight all work on a raster DSM and emit rasters, and solar_radiation computes irradiance — none produces shadow geometry, so questions like 'is this window shaded' or 'how much of this plot's airspace is in shadow' cannot be answered. The output composes with inside_3d, intersect_3d and union_3d.

input.label: Input
input.description: 3D building solids or extruded footprints (triangle-mesh MultiPolygons with Z).

output.label: Output
output.description: Closed shadow-volume solids. If omitted, stored in memory.

datetime.label: Datetime
datetime.description: Local date-time of the sun position as 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM' or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'. Taken as a parameter, never from a clock, so results are reproducible.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, used for the solar geometry. Required: it cannot be derived without a projection engine.

utc_offset.label: Utc Offset
utc_offset.description: Hours from UTC of the supplied local time (default 0).

adjusted_for_dst.label: Adjusted For Dst
adjusted_for_dst.description: Treat the supplied time as daylight-saving-adjusted, subtracting an hour before the solar calculation (default false), matching ArcGIS.

ground_elevation.label: Ground Elevation
ground_elevation.description: Constant ground Z the shadow is projected onto. Default: each feature's own minimum Z.

max_length.label: Max Length
max_length.description: Cap on the sweep distance in CRS units, so a low sun does not produce a kilometres-long prism. Default: unlimited.

surface_difference.name: Surface Difference
surface_difference.description: Delineates where one surface lies above, below or level with another as polygons, each carrying its class, area, volume and difference statistics (ArcGIS Surface Difference). cut_fill measures the same quantities but emits only a region-label raster and a CSV, so its regions have no geometry to overlay, clip or join; surface_volume and polygon_volume measure against a plane or within polygons you already have rather than discovering them.

input.label: Input
input.description: Surface raster to classify.

reference.label: Reference
reference.description: Reference surface: a co-registered raster path, or a constant elevation to compare against a flat datum.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output polygon layer of the classified regions. If omitted, stored in memory.

output_raster.label: Output Raster
output_raster.description: Output signed difference raster (input minus reference). Always produced; stored in memory when no path is given.

tolerance.label: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Differences within this of zero count as coincident (default 0.0).

min_area.label: Min Area
min_area.description: Discard regions smaller than this area in map units squared.

include_coincident.label: Include Coincident
include_coincident.description: Emit polygons for the unchanged class too (default false). Off by default because on most scenes it is one enormous background polygon.

surface_parameters.name: Surface Parameters
surface_parameters.description: Slope, aspect, or curvature (mean/profile/tangential/plan/gaussian/casorati/contour_geodesic_torsion) from a DEM via a local quadratic/biquadratic least-squares surface fit over a chosen neighborhood distance, like ArcGIS Surface Parameters — the scale-adaptive counterpart to the bundled fixed 3×3 terrain tools.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input elevation raster (DEM).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output raster path. If omitted, stored in memory.

parameter.label: Parameter
parameter.description: Which parameter to compute: slope (default), aspect, mean_curvature, profile_curvature, tangential_curvature, plan_curvature, gaussian_curvature, casorati_curvature, contour_geodesic_torsion.

neighborhood_distance.label: Neighborhood Distance
neighborhood_distance.description: Neighborhood radius in map units (default = one cell size, i.e. a 3×3 window).

neighborhood_type.label: Neighborhood Type
neighborhood_type.description: 'fixed' (default) uses the full radius everywhere; 'adaptive' shrinks the window to 1 cell next to data gaps/edges.

surface_volume.name: Surface Volume
surface_volume.description: Integrate a raster surface against a horizontal reference plane, reporting 2D area, 3D surface area, and volume for the portion above and/or below the plane (like ArcGIS's Surface Volume). Earthworks cut/fill and reservoir-capacity analysis.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input elevation surface raster.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: Which side of the plane to integrate: 'above', 'below', or 'both' (default 'above').

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output CSV path for the results table. If omitted, results are returned in the run result only.

table_to_geometry.name: Table To Geometry
table_to_geometry.description: Build line or ellipse features from tabular fields: start/end coordinate pairs (XY To Line), origin + bearing + distance (Bearing Distance To Line), or center + major/minor axis + azimuth (Table To Ellipse) — with planar, geodesic, and rhumb line construction.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input attribute table or point vector layer.

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (driver from its extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

line_type.label: Line Type
line_type.description: 'geodesic' (default, shortest path on the WGS84 ellipsoid), 'rhumb' (constant bearing), or 'planar' (straight Cartesian segments in the input's own units).

vertex_spacing.label: Vertex Spacing
vertex_spacing.description: Densification spacing for curved (geodesic/rhumb) lines, and ellipse outline sample spacing, in meters for geodesic/rhumb or CRS units for planar. Default: a fixed segment count.

polygon_output.label: Polygon Output
polygon_output.description: mode=ellipse only: emit a filled Polygon instead of a closed line outline. Default false.

start_x.label: Start X
start_x.description: mode=xy_to_line: field holding the start X / longitude.

start_y.label: Start Y
start_y.description: mode=xy_to_line: field holding the start Y / latitude.

end_x.label: End X
end_x.description: mode=xy_to_line: field holding the end X / longitude.

end_y.label: End Y
end_y.description: mode=xy_to_line: field holding the end Y / latitude.

x.label: X
x.description: mode=bearing_distance/ellipse: field holding the origin/center X / longitude.

y.label: Y
y.description: mode=bearing_distance/ellipse: field holding the origin/center Y / latitude.

bearing.label: Bearing
bearing.description: mode=bearing_distance: field holding the bearing in degrees clockwise from north.

distance.label: Distance
distance.description: mode=bearing_distance: field holding the travel distance (meters for geodesic/rhumb, CRS units for planar).

major.label: Major
major.description: mode=ellipse: field holding the semi-major axis length (meters for geodesic/rhumb, CRS units for planar).

minor.label: Minor
minor.description: mode=ellipse: field holding the semi-minor axis length (same units as major).

azimuth.label: Azimuth
azimuth.description: mode=ellipse: field holding the major-axis direction in degrees clockwise from north.

tabulate_intersection.name: Tabulate Intersection
tabulate_intersection.description: Vector-on-vector zonal summary: apportion a class layer (polygons by area, lines by intersected length, or points by count) across zone polygons, reporting intersected measure, percentage of zone, and measure-weighted sum fields.

input.label: Input
input.description: Zone polygon layer, format auto-detected (or in-memory handle).

class_features.label: Class Features
class_features.description: Class vector layer to apportion across the zones (polygons summarized by area, lines by intersected length, or points by count).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (driver from its extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

class_field.label: Class Field
class_field.description: Optional categorical field in the class layer; results are grouped by zone x this value. Omit to treat all class features as one class.

sum_fields.label: Sum Fields
sum_fields.description: Optional comma-separated numeric fields in the class layer to apportion into each zone (area-weighted for polygons, length-weighted for lines, summed for points).

zone_field.label: Zone Field
zone_field.description: Optional field identifying each zone in the output. Defaults to the zone feature index.

thin_road_network.name: Thin Road Network
thin_road_network.description: Generalize a road network for small-scale display: hide short, low-hierarchy roads while preserving connectivity, flagging each road visible/thinned (non-destructive) like ArcGIS Thin Road Network.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input road (line) vector layer, format auto-detected (or in-memory handle).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (driver from its extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

min_length.label: Min Length
min_length.description: Roads shorter than this (CRS units) are candidates to thin out. Longer roads are always kept.

hierarchy_field.label: Hierarchy Field
hierarchy_field.description: Optional numeric road-class field; lower value = more important (kept longer). Candidates are thinned highest-class-number first.

visibility_field.label: Visibility Field
visibility_field.description: Name of the output visibility flag field (1 = kept, 0 = thinned). Default 'visible'.

keep_only.label: Keep Only
keep_only.description: If true, output only the visible roads instead of flagging all of them. Default false (non-destructive).

snap_tolerance.label: Snap Tolerance
snap_tolerance.description: Distance within which road endpoints are treated as the same junction. Default 1e-6.

tile_grid_polygons.name: Tile Grid Polygons
tile_grid_polygons.description: Emits web-map tile boundaries as polygons for a zoom level (or range) and extent, each carrying z/x/y and its quadkey (ArcGIS Map Server Cache Tiling Scheme To Polygons, Create Vector Tile Index, Generate Tile Cache Tiling Scheme). The bundled rectangular/hexagonal grid tools build arbitrary grids in the input CRS and cannot coincide with the WebMercator quadtree the PMTiles and raster_to_tiles tools use.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.description: Zoom level. Use with 'max_zoom' to emit a pyramid of levels.

max_zoom.label: Max Zoom
max_zoom.description: Optional highest zoom; when given, every level from 'zoom' to 'max_zoom' is emitted.

extent.label: Extent
extent.description: Optional raster or vector layer whose bounds clip the grid. Without it, the whole world at that zoom (subject to 'max_tiles').

bbox.label: Bbox
bbox.description: Optional explicit extent as 'min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat' in degrees. Takes precedence over 'extent'.

scheme.label: Scheme
scheme.description: 'xyz' (default, Google/OSM, y counts down from the north) or 'tms' (y counts up from the south).

max_tiles.label: Max Tiles
max_tiles.description: Hard cap on the number of tiles (default 1000000); exceeding it is an error naming the computed count.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output polygon layer. If omitted, stored in memory.

time_series_clustering.name: Time Series Clustering
time_series_clustering.description: Cluster the cells of an H3 space-time cube by the similarity of their time series (value, z-normalized profile, or correlation) with deterministic k-medoids, so places that evolve alike group together, like ArcGIS Time Series Clustering.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input point layer in EPSG:4326 (lon/lat) with a timestamp field.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output H3 polygon layer with cluster_id/is_medoid. If omitted, stored in memory.

time_step.label: Time Step
time_step.description: Width of a time step: a plain number (numeric time_field) or a duration like '1w', '7d', '12h'. Default '1w'.

value_field.label: Value Field
value_field.description: Optional numeric field summed into each bin. Default: count of points per bin.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: H3 resolution 0 (coarsest) to 15 (finest); default 7 (~5 km² cells).

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducible medoid initialization (default 1).

time_series_cross_correlation.name: Time Series Cross Correlation
time_series_cross_correlation.description: Per-cell lagged cross-correlation between two aligned space-time raster stacks (like ArcGIS's Time Series Cross Correlation / Multidimensional Raster Correlation): for each cell, optionally detrend/deseasonalize, then correlate series A against series B across min_lag..=max_lag and report the best lag and its Pearson correlation, plus optional lag-0 correlation and a Pyper-Peterman effective-sample-size pseudo p-value. The two-variable, lag-aware complement to the single-series generate_trend_raster / change_point_detection cube tools — nothing bundled relates two variables through time.

input.label: Input
input.description: Stack A: a multiband raster (one band per time step) OR a comma-separated list of co-registered single-band raster paths in time order.

secondary.label: Secondary
secondary.description: Stack B: same shape and length as 'input' (multiband raster or comma-separated single-band list).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output best-lag raster (integer lag maximizing |correlation|). If omitted, stored in memory.

corr_output.label: Corr Output
corr_output.description: Optional output raster of the (signed) Pearson correlation at the best lag.

corr0_output.label: Corr0 Output
corr0_output.description: Optional output raster of the correlation at lag 0 (contemporaneous).

pvalue_output.label: Pvalue Output
pvalue_output.description: Optional output raster of a pseudo two-sided p-value at the best lag (Pyper-Peterman effective sample size + Fisher z).

min_lag.label: Min Lag
min_lag.description: Minimum lag in time steps (default -6). A[t] is paired with B[t+lag].

max_lag.label: Max Lag
max_lag.description: Maximum lag in time steps (default 6). Must be >= min_lag.

detrend.label: Detrend
detrend.description: If true, subtract a per-series OLS linear trend before correlating (default false).

deseasonalize.label: Deseasonalize
deseasonalize.description: If true, subtract a per-series additive seasonal cycle of period 'season_length' before correlating (default false).

season_length.label: Season Length
season_length.description: Seasonal period (time steps) used when 'deseasonalize' is true (default 12).

min_valid.label: Min Valid
min_valid.description: Minimum valid overlapping pairs required to correlate at a lag (default 5).

band.label: Band
band.description: 1-based band to read when a stack is given as a comma-separated single-band list (default 1). Ignored for multiband stacks.

time_series_forecast.name: Time Series Forecast
time_series_forecast.description: Per-location forecasting on an H3 space-time cube (like ArcGIS Exponential Smoothing / Curve Fit Forecast): forecast each cell's series ahead by Holt's exponential smoothing or polynomial curve fits, picking per cell the lowest hold-out-RMSE model, with next/final-step forecasts and a 90% confidence half-width. The temporal forecasting the bundled spatial trend_surface can't do.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input point layer of timestamped events (lon/lat).

time_field.label: Time Field
time_field.description: Field holding each point's time: a number or an ISO-8601 timestamp.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output H3 polygon layer with forecast attributes. If omitted, stored in memory.

value_field.label: Value Field
value_field.description: Numeric field to aggregate per bin (default: point count).

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Number of time steps to forecast ahead (default 3).

holdout.label: Holdout
holdout.description: Time steps held out to validate/select the model (default 3).

time_step.label: Time Step
time_step.description: Width of a time step in the time_field's units (default 1).

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: H3 resolution 0..15 (default 7).

time_series_smoothing.name: Time Series Smoothing
time_series_smoothing.description: Smooth an in-sample time series per location (like ArcGIS Time Series Smoothing): group features by id_field, order each group by time_field, and append a smoothed value via a backward/centered/forward moving average or adaptive-bandwidth local-linear (LOESS) pass. Geometry and all original attributes are preserved. Complements time_series_forecast, which projects ahead rather than smoothing the observed series.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input feature layer of timestamped observations.

value_field.label: Value Field
value_field.description: Numeric field whose series is smoothed.

time_field.label: Time Field
time_field.description: Field ordering each series: a number or an ISO-8601 timestamp.

id_field.label: Id Field
id_field.description: Field identifying each location/series. If omitted, all features form one series.

window.label: Window
window.description: moving_average: number of points in the averaging window (default 3).

bandwidth.label: Bandwidth
bandwidth.description: local_linear: number of nearest-in-time points used per local fit (default 5).

output_field.label: Output Field
output_field.description: Name of the appended smoothed field (default 'smoothed').

output.label: Output
output.description: Output layer path. If omitted, stored in memory.

topo_to_raster.name: Topo To Raster
topo_to_raster.description: Interpolate a hydrologically correct DEM from contour lines, spot-height points, and optional stream lines using a minimum-curvature (thin-plate) relaxation with drainage enforcement — like ArcGIS Topo To Raster (ANUDEM). Unlike the bundled IDW/TIN/spline interpolators it does not terrace contours and it removes spurious closed depressions.

contours.label: Contours
contours.description: Input contour line vector layer (elevation read from elevation_field). At least one of contours/points is required.

points.label: Points
points.description: Input spot-height point vector layer (elevation read from elevation_field).

streams.label: Streams
streams.description: Optional stream line vector layer used for drainage enforcement (burned into the surface before sink removal).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output DEM raster path (driver from extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

elevation_field.label: Elevation Field
elevation_field.description: Name of the numeric elevation field on the contour and point layers. Default: auto-detect (HEIGHT/ELEV/ELEVATION/Z, else the first numeric field).

cell_size.label: Cell Size
cell_size.description: Output cell size in CRS units. Default: sized so the longer grid axis is ~400 cells.

tension.label: Tension
tension.description: Surface stiffness in [0,1]: 0 = pure thin-plate (smoothest), 1 = taut membrane. Default 0.35.

iterations.label: Iterations
iterations.description: Maximum SOR iterations (default 2000). Iteration stops early once the max cell change falls below tolerance.

tolerance.label: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Convergence tolerance: stop when the largest cell change in an iteration is below this (CRS elevation units). Default 0.01.

enforce_drainage.label: Enforce Drainage
enforce_drainage.description: Remove spurious interior sinks after interpolation so the DEM drains to its edges (default true).

stream_burn.label: Stream Burn
stream_burn.description: Depth (elevation units) to lower stream cells before sink removal, to route flow along them. Default 0 (auto = 1% of relief when streams are supplied).

trace_proximity_events.name: Trace Proximity Events
trace_proximity_events.description: Find intervals where two moving tracks were within a distance of each other for at least a minimum duration (proximity events), and optionally trace transitive downstream contacts from seed entities, like ArcGIS Trace Proximity Events.

input.label: Input
input.description: Timestamped point layer (use a projected CRS; distances are in map units).

track_field.label: Track Field
track_field.description: Field identifying each moving entity / track.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output proximity-event line layer. If omitted, stored in memory.

search_distance.label: Search Distance
search_distance.description: Maximum separation for two tracks to be 'in proximity' (map units).

min_duration.label: Min Duration
min_duration.description: Minimum time in proximity to count as an event: seconds or a duration like '5m', '1h' (default 0).

entities.label: Entities
entities.description: Optional comma-separated seed track ids to trace downstream contacts from (contact tracing).

depth.label: Depth
depth.description: Maximum tracing generations from the seeds (default unlimited).

transform_features.name: Transform Features
transform_features.description: Apply an affine transform (shift, rotate about an anchor, per-axis scale, mirror) to every geometry in a vector layer.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector file path, format auto-detected (or in-memory handle).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (driver from its extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

dx.label: Dx
dx.description: Shift applied to X after scale/mirror/rotation, in CRS units. Default 0.

dy.label: Dy
dy.description: Shift applied to Y after scale/mirror/rotation, in CRS units. Default 0.

angle.label: Angle
angle.description: Counter-clockwise rotation about the anchor, in degrees. Default 0.

scale_x.label: Scale X
scale_x.description: Scale factor about the anchor along X. Default 1.

scale_y.label: Scale Y
scale_y.description: Scale factor about the anchor along Y. Default 1.

mirror_axis.label: Mirror Axis
mirror_axis.description: Reflect through the anchor: NONE (default), X (flip Y across the horizontal axis), or Y (flip X across the vertical axis).

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.description: Pivot for scale/mirror/rotation: CENTROID (bounding-box center, default), ORIGIN (0,0), or XY (use anchor_x/anchor_y).

anchor_x.label: Anchor X
anchor_x.description: Anchor X coordinate; required when anchor=XY.

anchor_y.label: Anchor Y
anchor_y.description: Anchor Y coordinate; required when anchor=XY.

transform_fields.name: Transform Fields
transform_fields.description: Standardize, transform, and encode attribute fields (like ArcGIS Standardize/Transform/Encode Field): z-score, min-max, robust, log/log1p/sqrt/boxcox/inverse, equal-interval/quantile/std-dev binning, and one-hot encoding.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer (or table) with the fields to transform.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated field names to transform; the same transform is applied to each.

transform.label: Transform
transform.description: Transform to apply: zscore, minmax, robust, log, log1p, sqrt, boxcox, inverse, bin, onehot.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector layer with the transformed fields added. If omitted, stored in memory.

bin_method.label: Bin Method
bin_method.description: Classification method for 'bin': equal_interval (default), quantile, or std_dev.

boxcox_lambda.label: Boxcox Lambda
boxcox_lambda.description: Fixed lambda for 'boxcox'; if omitted, fit by maximum likelihood (golden-section search).

suffix.label: Suffix
suffix.description: Output field name suffix (default depends on transform, e.g. '_z' for zscore).

drop_input.label: Drop Input
drop_input.description: If true, remove the original field(s) from the output after transforming (default false).

transform_route_events.name: Transform Route Events
transform_route_events.description: Re-reference point events measured against a source route system onto a target route system: recover each event's XY from its source route and measure, then relocate it onto the nearest target route within a cluster tolerance, emitting the target route id and measure — like ArcGIS Transform Route Events.

source_events.label: Source Events
source_events.description: Input point event layer. Each feature carries a route identifier (route_id_field) and a measure (measure_field).

source_routes.label: Source Routes
source_routes.description: Source route system: line layer whose features are keyed by route_id_field. Measures are distance from each route's first vertex.

target_routes.label: Target Routes
target_routes.description: Target route system: line layer onto which events are relocated. Route identifiers come from target_id_field.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output point vector path (driver from extension). If omitted, the result is stored in memory.

route_id_field.label: Route Id Field
route_id_field.description: Field naming the route identifier in source_events and source_routes (default 'route_id'). Absent field -> the source route feature index is used.

measure_field.label: Measure Field
measure_field.description: Numeric field in source_events holding the source-system measure (default 'measure').

target_id_field.label: Target Id Field
target_id_field.description: Field naming the route identifier in target_routes (default: same as route_id_field). Absent field -> the target route feature index is used.

cluster_tolerance.label: Cluster Tolerance
cluster_tolerance.description: Maximum XY distance (CRS units) from the recovered event location to a target route for the event to transfer. 0 or omitted means no limit (always snap to the nearest target route).

transpose_fields.name: Transpose Fields
transpose_fields.description: Reshapes a wide attribute table to long form: each listed value column becomes its own row, tagged with the column it came from (ArcGIS Transpose Fields). pivot_table only goes long-to-wide, so tables arriving with one column per period could not be fed to the time-series tools that need one row per observation.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector layer or table.

transpose_fields.label: Transpose Fields
transpose_fields.description: Comma- or semicolon-separated value columns to unpivot.

value_field.label: Value Field
value_field.description: Name of the output column holding the cell value (default 'VALUE').

transposed_field.label: Transposed Field
transposed_field.description: Name of the output column holding the source column name (default 'FIELD').

field_labels.label: Field Labels
field_labels.description: Optional labels written into 'transposed_field' instead of the raw column names, e.g. '2000,2010,2020'. Must have the same length as 'transpose_fields'.

retain_fields.label: Retain Fields
retain_fields.description: Attributes copied onto every output row. Defaults to all non-transposed fields.

drop_nulls.label: Drop Nulls
drop_nulls.description: Skip output rows whose value is null (default false).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output layer. If omitted, stored in memory.

trim_line.name: Trim Line
trim_line.description: Delete short dangling line segments (overshoots and spurs) shorter than a length tolerance, keeping true intersections and long lines.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input line vector file path, format auto-detected (or in-memory handle).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output vector path (driver from its extension). If omitted, stored in memory.

dangle_length.label: Dangle Length
dangle_length.description: Length tolerance in CRS units. A dangling segment shorter than this is trimmed; longer dangles are kept. Must be positive.

keep_short.label: Keep Short
keep_short.description: When true (default), short segments that are unconnected at both ends (isolated) are kept; when false they are also deleted. Segments dangling at exactly one end are always trimmed when short.

snap_tolerance.label: Snap Tolerance
snap_tolerance.description: Endpoints within this distance (CRS units) are treated as the same node. Default 1e-6.

union_3d.name: Union 3D
union_3d.description: Computes the combined volume of overlapping closed 3D solids without double-counting their intersections, plus per-pair overlap volumes (ArcGIS Union 3D). Neither registry has any 3D overlay, so summing buffer_3d capsules or minimum_bounding_volume hulls today double-counts every overlap; polygon_volume and surface_volume only measure against a reference plane. Per-solid volumes are exact (signed-tetrahedron summation); the union is estimated by voxel occupancy at a reported resolution.

input.label: Input
input.description: Closed 3D solid features (triangle-mesh MultiPolygons with Z, as buffer_3d and minimum_bounding_volume emit).

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output table path of per-group volumes. If omitted, stored in memory.

group_field.label: Group Field
group_field.description: Optional field; solids are unioned within each group value rather than across the whole layer.

output_overlap_table.label: Output Overlap Table
output_overlap_table.description: Optional path for the per-pair overlap volumes. If omitted, stored in memory (still returned).

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Voxel samples per axis used to estimate the union volume, 4 to 512 (default 96). Higher is more accurate and slower.

unwrap_phase.name: Unwrap Phase
unwrap_phase.description: Converts wrapped interferometric phase in (-pi, pi] into a continuous absolute field by weighted least squares, solved with preconditioned conjugate gradient, with optional coherence weighting and masking (ArcGIS Unwrap Phase). Nothing in either registry unwraps phase — raster_calculator cannot express the global solve and the bundled speckle filters smooth rather than unwrap — so sar_coherence's phase output and flatten_interferogram currently have no continuous endpoint.

input.label: Input
input.description: Wrapped-phase raster in radians, or a two-band I/Q interferogram.

output.label: Output
output.description: Unwrapped continuous phase raster. If omitted, stored in memory.

coherence.label: Coherence
coherence.description: Optional co-registered coherence raster used as per-edge solve weights, so low-coherence pixels pull the solution less.

coherence_threshold.label: Coherence Threshold
coherence_threshold.description: Mask out pixels whose coherence falls below this (default 0.3). Ignored when no coherence raster is given. Masking that splits the valid pixels into disconnected components leaves each component other than the reference pixel's with its own arbitrary additive constant.

tolerance.label: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Relative residual at which the solve stops (default 1e-8).

reference_row.label: Reference Row
reference_row.description: Row of the pixel pinned to zero, fixing the solution's additive constant. Default: the first valid pixel.

reference_col.label: Reference Col
reference_col.description: Column of the pinned pixel. Default: the first valid pixel.

band.label: Band
band.description: 1-based band holding the phase. Omit it for a single-band phase raster or a two-band I/Q interferogram (which is then auto-detected); supply it to read real phase from a specific band of a multiband stack. A raster with more than two bands REQUIRES this parameter, because three or more bands are not an I/Q pair and guessing would return plausible but wrong phase.

validate_flow_direction.name: Validate Flow Direction
validate_flow_direction.description: Reports the cells that make a flow-direction raster unusable — codes that are not D8 directions, interior cells with no outlet, flow into no-data, flow off the edge, and cells on a circular flow path — as a point layer of problems (ArcGIS Validate Flow Direction). The bundled hydrology suite consumes pointer rasters everywhere (d8_flow_accumulation, watershed, basins, trace_downslope_flowpaths) but nothing validates one, so a raster broken by resampling, reclassing or clipping yields a plausible wrong answer rather than an error, and a routing loop can hang.

input.label: Input
input.description: Flow-direction (pointer) raster to check.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output point layer, one point per problem cell. If omitted, stored in memory.

flow_direction_type.label: Flow Direction Type
flow_direction_type.description: 'd8' (default) for single power-of-two codes, or 'mfd' where a value may be the sum of several directions.

report_edge_outflow.label: Report Edge Outflow
report_edge_outflow.description: Report cells whose flow leaves the raster (default false). Normal on a true boundary, a real defect on a clipped interior.

vector_convert.name: Vector Convert
vector_convert.description: Convert a vector dataset to another format (the output extension picks the driver).

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector file path (format auto-detected) or in-memory handle.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector path; the driver is taken from its extension (.geojson, .fgb, .shp, .gpkg, .parquet, ...). If omitted, the layer is stored in memory.

vector_to_h3.name: Vector to H3 Bins
vector_to_h3.description: Bin a vector layer into H3 discrete-global-grid cells, counting features per cell.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector file path (must be geographic lon/lat, EPSG:4326) or in-memory handle.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output vector path; the driver is taken from its extension (.geojson, .fgb, .parquet, ...). If omitted, the layer is stored in memory.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: H3 resolution 0 (coarsest) to 15 (finest); default 8 (~0.7 km² cells).

vector_to_pmtiles.name: Vector to PMTiles
vector_to_pmtiles.description: Pack a vector layer into a single PMTiles archive (Mapbox Vector Tile pyramid).

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector file path (GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoPackage, FlatGeobuf, GeoParquet, ...).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output PMTiles file path (e.g. /work/roads.pmtiles).

layer_name.label: Layer Name
layer_name.description: Name of the layer inside the tiles, used when styling (default: the input layer's name).

simplify.label: Simplify
simplify.description: Simplify geometries per zoom level (default true).

drop_rate.label: Drop Rate
drop_rate.description: Rate at which features are dropped at low zooms, as in tippecanoe (default: no dropping).

voxel_isosurface.name: Voxel Isosurface
voxel_isosurface.description: Extracts a triangulated isosurface at one or more threshold values from a 3D voxel field via marching tetrahedra (ArcGIS Export Voxel Isosurface). The whole contouring suite in both registries is 2D — lines from a plane; this is the volumetric analogue, turning the output of idw_3d or a multidimensional raster into renderable geometry. Emits the triangle-mesh convention used by buffer_3d and minimum_bounding_volume, so results feed straight into inside_3d.

input.label: Input
input.description: Voxel field as a multi-band raster: band k is the Z slice at z_min + k * z_spacing.

values.label: Values
values.description: Threshold value(s): a number, a JSON array of numbers, or a comma-separated string. One surface per value.

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output path for the triangle-mesh surfaces. If omitted, stored in memory.

z_min.label: Z Min
z_min.description: Z coordinate of the first slice (default 0).

close_boundaries.label: Close Boundaries
close_boundaries.description: Cap surfaces where they meet the volume edge so the result bounds a closed solid (default true). Implemented by marching an extra below-iso shell, so the cap is welded to the surface; it lies between the boundary plane and one cell beyond it. This seals the OUTER faces only: cells touching interior no-data are skipped, so a no-data pocket that intersects the extracted surface still leaves an open rim (one lying wholly inside or outside the contour never meets the mesh).

smooth.label: Smooth
smooth.description: Laplacian smoothing iterations applied to the extracted mesh (default 0).

warp_raster.name: Warp Raster
warp_raster.description: Georeference a raster from ground control points (like ArcGIS Warp): fit an order 1/2/3 polynomial from source-pixel → world-coordinate GCP pairs and resample into a new georeferenced grid (nearest/bilinear), reporting per-GCP residuals and RMS error. The raster half of the conflation story the vector rubbersheet_features already covers.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input raster (its pixel grid is the source coordinate space).

gcps.label: Gcps
gcps.description: Ground control points as 'col,row,x,y' quads separated by ';' (>= 3 for order 1, 6 for order 2, 10 for order 3).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output georeferenced raster. If omitted, stored in memory.

cell_size.label: Cell Size
cell_size.description: Output cell size in world units (default: input width mapped to the target extent).

epsg.label: Epsg
epsg.description: EPSG code to tag the output CRS (optional).

weighted_voronoi.name: Weighted Voronoi
weighted_voronoi.description: Weighted Voronoi allocation raster (market/dominance areas): assign each cell to the site with the smallest weighted distance — multiplicative (d/w, Apollonius), additive (d-w), or power (d²-w²) — like ArcGIS Generate Weighted Voronoi. The unequal-site version of the bundled unweighted voronoi_diagram.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input point layer of sites.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output allocation raster (1-based site index per cell). If omitted, stored in memory.

weight_field.label: Weight Field
weight_field.description: Numeric field giving each site's weight/attractiveness (default: all sites weight 1).

cell_size.label: Cell Size
cell_size.description: Output cell size in CRS units (default: extent / 400).

margin.label: Margin
margin.description: Fraction of the site extent to pad the raster by (default 0.1).

epsg.label: Epsg
epsg.description: EPSG to tag the output (default: from the input layer).

write_geoparquet.name: Write GeoParquet
write_geoparquet.description: Convert a vector dataset (GeoJSON, Shapefile, FlatGeobuf, GeoPackage, ...) to GeoParquet, Hilbert-sorted and ZSTD-compressed by default.

input.label: Input
input.description: Input vector file path (format auto-detected) or in-memory handle.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output GeoParquet file path (e.g. /work/data.parquet).

compression.label: Compression
compression.description: Column compression: zstd (default), snappy, gzip, or uncompressed.

hilbert_sort.label: Hilbert Sort
hilbert_sort.description: Sort features along a Hilbert curve for spatial locality (default true).

write_pmtiles.name: Raster to PMTiles
write_pmtiles.description: Render a raster into a single PMTiles archive (Web Mercator PNG tile pyramid).

input.label: Input
input.description: Input raster file path. Must carry a source CRS (EPSG or WKT).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output PMTiles file path (e.g. /work/dem.pmtiles).

min_zoom.label: Min Zoom
min_zoom.description: Minimum zoom level (default: a single native zoom matching the raster resolution).

max_zoom.label: Max Zoom
max_zoom.description: Maximum zoom level (default: same as min_zoom).

colormap.label: Colormap
colormap.description: Colormap: viridis (default), magma, turbo, terrain, or grayscale.

min.label: Min
min.description: Value mapped to the low end of the colormap (default: band minimum).

max.label: Max
max.description: Value mapped to the high end of the colormap (default: band maximum).

zonal_characterization.name: Zonal Characterization
zonal_characterization.description: Compute statistics for several value rasters over one zone raster in a single pass, with a per-raster statistic and arbitrary percentiles, like ArcGIS Zonal Characterization.

zones.label: Zones
zones.description: Zone raster; each distinct value defines a zone.

rasters.label: Rasters
rasters.description: Comma-separated 'path:statistic[:name]' entries, e.g. 'dem.tif:mean,ndvi.tif:median'. Value rasters use band 1. Statistics: mean, sum, min, max, range, stddev, median, majority, minority, variety, count, percentile.

output.label: Output
output.description: Optional output statistics table path. If omitted, stored in memory.

percentile.label: Percentile
percentile.description: Percentile (0-100) applied to any raster whose statistic is 'percentile' (default 50).

zone_band.label: Zone Band
zone_band.description: 1-based band to read from the zone raster (default 1).

ignore_nodata.label: Ignore Nodata
ignore_nodata.description: Skip no-data cells in the value rasters (default true). When false, any no-data in a zone makes that zone's statistic null.

zonal_fill.name: Zonal Fill
zonal_fill.description: Fill each zone of a categorical raster with the minimum value of a weight raster found along that zone's boundary (like ArcGIS Zonal Fill) — a constrained-surface building block absent from the bundled suite (fill is flow-based, zonal_statistics only summarizes).

zones.label: Zones
zones.description: Categorical zone raster (each distinct integer value is one zone).

weight.label: Weight
weight.description: Co-registered weight raster whose boundary minimum fills each zone.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output raster. If omitted, stored in memory.

zonal_geometry.name: Zonal Geometry
zonal_geometry.description: Per-zone geometric measures from a categorical zone raster (like ArcGIS Zonal Geometry): area, perimeter, thickness, centroid, and standard-deviational ellipse major/minor axis + orientation — the zone-shape counterpart the bundled value-based zonal_statistics and zonal_histogram don't provide.

zones.label: Zones
zones.description: Categorical zone raster (each distinct integer value is one zone).

output.label: Output
output.description: Output raster (raster mode) or CSV path (as_table mode). If omitted, stored in memory / returned in the result only.

as_table.label: As Table
as_table.description: When true, emit one row per zone with every measure instead of a per-cell raster (default false).

zonal_histogram.name: Zonal Histogram
zonal_histogram.description: Tabulate the distribution of a value raster's cells within each zone: class counts (categorical) or binned frequencies (continuous), as a zones x classes cross-tab table.

zones.label: Zones
zones.description: Zone raster file path (integer/categorical zone ids).

value.label: Value
value.description: Value raster file path; must share the grid of 'zones'.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output CSV path: one row per zone, one column per class/bin.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: 'classes' (default) treats each rounded value as its own class, for integer/categorical value rasters. 'bins' buckets continuous values into equal-width bins.

bins.label: Bins
bins.description: Number of equal-width bins for 'bins' mode. Default 10.

percent.label: Percent
percent.description: Emit each class's percentage of the zone's valid cells instead of raw cell counts. Default false.

long_output.label: Long Output
long_output.description: Optional CSV path for the long-format (zone,class,count,percent) variant.

extract_cog_subset.name: Extract COG Subset
extract_cog_subset.description: Extract a bbox subset from a local or HTTP Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF.

input.label: Input
input.description: Local COG file. Provide either input or url.

url.label: Url
url.description: HTTP(S) COG URL. Provide either url or input; HTTP sources use byte-range requests.

bbox.label: Bbox
bbox.description: Bounding box as minX,minY,maxX,maxY in bbox_crs.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output COG path.

level.label: Level
level.description: COG overview level to read; 0 is full resolution.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Target output pixel size. Uses output_crs units when output_crs is set; otherwise bbox_crs units. Selects the closest COG overview when level is omitted.

output_crs.label: Output Crs
output_crs.description: Optional output EPSG code. When set, the subset is reprojected to this CRS. For source CRSs that cannot be written as EPSG metadata, defaults to bbox_crs.

nodata.label: Nodata
nodata.description: Optional output nodata value. Used as reprojection fill and written as output nodata metadata.

extract_wms_subset.name: Extract WMS Subset
extract_wms_subset.description: Request a bbox subset from a WMS GetMap endpoint and write it as a Deflate COG.

styles.label: Styles
styles.description: WMS style name(s), comma-separated. Defaults to empty.

bbox.label: Bbox
bbox.description: Bounding box as minX,minY,maxX,maxY in bbox_crs.

output.label: Output
output.description: Output COG path.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Target output pixel size in output_crs units when output_crs is set; otherwise bbox_crs units.

width.label: Width
width.description: Output request width in pixels. Used when resolution is omitted.

height.label: Height
height.description: Output request height in pixels. Used when resolution is omitted.

output_crs.label: Output Crs
output_crs.description: Optional output/request EPSG code. Defaults to bbox_crs.

format.label: Format
format.description: WMS image format. Defaults to image/geotiff.

extract_xyz_tile_subset.name: Extract XYZ Tile Subset
extract_xyz_tile_subset.description: Fetch XYZ raster tiles for a bbox, mosaic them, and write a Deflate RGB COG.

url.label: Url
url.description: XYZ tile URL template, e.g. https://.../{z}/{x}/{y}.png.

bbox.description: Bounding box as minX,minY,maxX,maxY in bbox_crs.

width.label: Width

output_crs.description: Optional output EPSG code. Defaults to bbox_crs.

nodata.label: Nodata
nodata.description: Optional output nodata value used for missing/transparent pixels.
